pals.name: Lamball
pals.description: A walk up a hill tends to end with this Pal tumbling back down. This causes it to become dizzy and unable to move, making it easy to capture and kill. As a result, this Pal has tumbled down to the very bottom of the food chain itself.

partnerSkill.name: Fluffy Shield
partnerSkill.description: When activated, equips to the player and becomes a shield. Sometimes drops wool| style=|status_keyword when assigned to Ranch.

pals.name: Cattiva
pals.description: At a glance it appears full of confidence, but it is in fact weak and cowardly. Being toyed with by a Cattiva is in many ways the greatest of disgraces.

partnerSkill.name: Cat Helper
partnerSkill.description: While in party, Cattiva helps carry supplies, increasing the player's max carrying capacity by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}</>. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Chikipi
pals.description: Extremely weak and far too delicious. It is one of the weakest Pals alongside Lamball. No matter how many are hunted, they just keep appearing.

partnerSkill.name: Egg Layer
partnerSkill.description: Sometimes lays an egg| style=|status_keyword when assigned to Ranch.

pals.name: Lifmunk
pals.description: Intelligent as a five to seven-year-old human child. It makes a wonderful partner, but there have been more than a few cases where they've killed their master after learning to use weapons.

partnerSkill.name: Lifmunk Recoil
partnerSkill.description: When activated, leaps onto the player's head and uses a submachine gun to follows up player attacks. {ReferenceMsgId_DamageUp}

pals.name: Fuack
pals.description: Using its own body water, this Pal can create waves anywhere. It body surfs when in a hurry, but the resulting speed often ends in a fatal collision.

partnerSkill.name: Surfing Slam
partnerSkill.description: When activated, Fuack body surfs towards an enemy and slams into them. {ReferenceMsgId_DamageUp}

pals.name: Fuack Ignis
pals.description: With a belly built for friction, this Pal sparks flames as it body surfs. But when it gets carried away, it often ends up a rolling fireball.

partnerSkill.name: Fire Tackle
partnerSkill.description: When activated, Fuack Ignis fire surfs towards an enemy and slams into them. {ReferenceMsgId_DamageUp}

pals.name: Vixy
pals.description: The idol of Palpagos Island. If you bully a Vixy, you best be prepared to become enemies with the whole world.

partnerSkill.name: Dig Here!
partnerSkill.description: Sometimes digs up items from the ground when assigned to Ranch.

pals.name: Celaray
pals.description: Riding the wind, this Pal travels where it pleases. Should it find a partner along the way, the encounter will mark its journey's end.

partnerSkill.name: Zephyr Glider
partnerSkill.description: While in party, modifies the performance of the equipped glider. <Status_Keyword>Prevents fall damage</> and extends the duration of high-speed gliding. {ReferenceMsgId_GriderPerformanceUp}

pals.name: Celaray Lux
pals.description: Its flashy patterns help it attract a partner. But after a long history of electrocution incidents involving Celaray Lux, yellow-and-black stripes are now seen across the island as a sign of danger.

partnerSkill.name: Jolt Glider
partnerSkill.description: While in party, modifies the performance of the equipped glider. <Status_Keyword>Prevents fall damage</> and extends the duration of high-speed gliding. {ReferenceMsgId_GriderPerformanceUp}

pals.name: Cremis
pals.description: Compared to Lamball, it has finer wool and a temperament more suited for domestication. However, it has historically always been kept as a pet. Cuteness is considered a virtue.

partnerSkill.name: Fluffy Wool
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases Attack of Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Normal| style=|Elem_Neutral) Pals by {Passive1_EffectValue1}%. (Does not stack) Sometimes drops wool| style=|status_keyword when assigned to Ranch.

pals.name: Croajiro
pals.description: Those who disgrace the honor of the herd are forced to take their own life. By piercing their inflated vocal sac with a tree branch, they are blown away into the atmosphere and return to the afterlife.

partnerSkill.name: Leap Stance
partnerSkill.description: When activated, Croajiro Noct channels its loyalty and puffs up its abdomen to store energy. Climbing on top will propel the player high into the air. While airborne before landing, the player's Attack is increased by <Status_Up>{ReferencePassive1_EffectValue1}%</>.

pals.name: Croajiro Noct
pals.description: The Croajiro who have forsaken their honor gather and form splinter groups. They will use any underhanded means to take down their chosen prey. If you encounter a pack of Croajiro Noct in the dead of the night, it's your life that's on the line.

partnerSkill.name: Shadow Stance
partnerSkill.description: When activated, Croajiro Noct channels its loyalty and puffs up its abdomen to store energy. Climbing on top will propel the player high into the air. While in party, improves player's and Pals' Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Dark| style=|Elem_Dark) damage to enemy weak points by {Passive1_EffectValue1}%. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Herbil
pals.description: When in doubt, punch it till it works—that’s Herbil's approach to fixing things. With strength perfectly tuned for humans, sometimes just one punch is enough to restart a stopped heart.

partnerSkill.name: Herbil Pulse
partnerSkill.description: While in party, Herbil uses its healing powers to <Status_Keyword>restore</> <Status_Up>{ActiveSkillMainValueByRank}%</> of the player's Max Health when incapacitated. {ReferenceMsgId_CooldownReduction}

pals.name: Teafant
pals.description: Large amounts of water pour from what is thought to be its nose, though some say that it is, in fact, just snot. This has sparked a fierce debate among Pal scholars.

partnerSkill.name: Soothing Shower
partnerSkill.description: While in party, restores <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</> of the player's Health when Health falls below 30%. (Does not stack) ({ReferencePassive1_EffectValue1}-second cooldown after activation)

pals.name: Gumoss
pals.description: A strange Pal with a body resembling tree sap. It gradually loses strength if it has nothing to cover its body with, eventually rotting away.

partnerSkill.name: Logging Assistance
partnerSkill.description: While in party, improves logging efficiency by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</> and reduces weight of <Status_Keyword>all types of wood</> by <Status_Up>{Passive2_EffectValue1}%</>. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Pupperai
pals.description: Pupperai territorial disputes begin with a staredown and end in a single, quick strike. Training them to |stay| is risky business, as the |go| command triggers that same attack instinct.

partnerSkill.name: Best Boy
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases the player's <Status_Keyword>melee weapon</> damage by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Clovee
pals.description: Some individuals once had three or more leaves on their foreheads. Regarded as symbols of good fortune, those with more leaves were heavily hunted, leading the species to evolve fewer leaves over time.

partnerSkill.name: Happy Clover
partnerSkill.description: While at a base, increases the Unknown Status (COMMON_WORK_SUITABILITY_Collection| style=|Status_Keyword) Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by <Status_Keyword>+{Passive1_EffectValue1}</>. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Jolthog
pals.description: It releases the electricity stored in its body when under attack. The voltage it generates exceeds 10 million volts, making it more lethal than any conventional heavy firearms when thrown.

partnerSkill.name: Jolt Bomb
partnerSkill.description: When activated, equips Jolthog to the player to be thrown at an enemy, causing an Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Electricity| style=|Elem_Electric) explosion upon impact. {ReferenceMsgId_DamageUp}

pals.name: Jolthog Cryst
pals.description: It releases the cold air stored in its body when under attack. The frigid blast it radiates is cold enough to freeze the surrounding air and easily pierces through any attacker's body.

partnerSkill.name: Cold Bomb
partnerSkill.description: When activated, equips Jolthog Cryst to the player to be thrown at an enemy, causing an Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Ice| style=|Elem_Ice) explosion upon impact. {ReferenceMsgId_DamageUp}

pals.name: Depresso
pals.description: It has few friends because of the perpetually grouchy look on its face, but it is in fact kindhearted. Some have seen it feeding Vixy who have strayed from their pack.

partnerSkill.name: Caffeine Inoculation
partnerSkill.description: When activated, Depresso chugs an entire energy drink, increasing its Movement Speed and Work Speed by <Status_Up>{ReferencePassive1_EffectValue1}%</>. Sometimes drops venom| style=|status_keyword when assigned to Ranch.

pals.name: Pengullet
pals.description: The feathers of this Pal have all but disappeared, but sadly, its desire to fly has remained as strong as ever. Even now, it tries to fly again in any way it can.

partnerSkill.name: Pengullet Launcher
partnerSkill.description: When activated, the player equips a Rocket Launcher to fire Pengullet as ammunition. Pengullet explodes on impact and is incapacitated. {ReferenceMsgId_DamageUp}

pals.name: Pengullet Lux
pals.description: The feathers of this Pal have all but disappeared, and it can no longer fly. Yet its longing for the sky has turned to jealousy— so it harnessed electricity to strike down those who still soar.

partnerSkill.name: Pengullet Lux Launcher
partnerSkill.description: When activated, the player equips Pengullet Lux to fire Rocket Launcher as ammunition. Pengullet Lux explodes on impact and is incapacitated. {ReferenceMsgId_DamageUp}

pals.name: Penking
pals.description: Surprisingly, it is unrelated to Pengullet. However, since this Pal gets pampered as it pleases, for now, it's doing its best to strut arrogantly.

partnerSkill.name: Brave Sailor
partnerSkill.description: While in party, Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Fire| style=|Elem_Fire) Pals drop {Passive1_EffectValue1}% more items when defeated. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Penking Lux
pals.description: Its body changed color after gaining electricity to improve underwater hunting. As a result, it lost the affection of Pengullet— but strangely enough, it now has a loyal follower: Pengullet Lux.

partnerSkill.name: Unyielding Storm Commander
partnerSkill.description: While in party, improves player's and Pals' Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Water| style=|Elem_Water) damage to enemy weak points by {Passive1_EffectValue1}%. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Hoocrates
pals.description: Often lost in thought, it sometimes finds it difficult to sleep. |I think, therefore I am.|

partnerSkill.name: Dark Knowledge
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases Attack of Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Dark| style=|Elem_Dark) Pals by {Passive1_EffectValue1}%. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Melpaca
pals.description: Don't be fooled by this Pal's fluffy appearance. A hypersonic kick from one of its long legs may send you flying to the other side of the world.

partnerSkill.name: Pacapaca Wool
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party, increases Kingpaca's Defense and Movement Speed. Sometimes drops wool| style=|status_keyword when assigned to Ranch.

pals.name: Kingpaca
pals.description: Melpaca serve this Pal. Contests between Kingpaca offer up their vassals as a wager. Those seen alone are losers of such contests.

partnerSkill.name: King of Muscles
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. This Pal's Defense and Movement Speed increase by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</> for each Unknown Character (Alpaca| style=|Status_Keyword) in party.

pals.name: Kingpaca Cryst
pals.description: With a heart of ice, this Pal is terrible at expressing its emotions. A solitary individual is pitiable, seen as too clumsy in the eyes of a Melpaca.

partnerSkill.name: Coldhearted King
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. This Pal's Defense and Movement Speed increase by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</> for each Unknown Character (Alpaca| style=|Status_Keyword) in party.

pals.name: Daedream
pals.description: It puts those it is interested in to sleep and shows them an endless stream of happy dreams. Those who fall under its spell are never to wake until death takes them.

partnerSkill.name: Dream Chaser
partnerSkill.description: While in party, appears near the player. Attacks hostile enemies with Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Dark| style=|Elem_Dark) magic bullets. These bullets will not reduce the target's Health below 1. {ReferenceMsgId_DamageUp}

pals.name: Tanzee
pals.description: Long ago, this Pal used long objects like tree branches as weapons. After coming into contact with humans, however, it found something slightly more effective: guns.

partnerSkill.name: Cheery Rifle
partnerSkill.description: When activated, Tanzee will mercilessly fire an assault rifle at nearby enemies for a limited time. {ReferenceMsgId_DamageUp}

pals.name: Tanzee Ignis
pals.description: Its palms have evolved to handle burning objects without getting scorched. When its gun runs out of ammo, it may grab the heated barrel with its bare hands and use it to club its foes.

partnerSkill.name: Chipper Chimp Gunfire
partnerSkill.description: When activated, Tanzee Ignis will mercilessly fire a Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Fire| style=|Elem_Fire) assault rifle at nearby enemies for a limited time. {ReferenceMsgId_DamageUp}

pals.name: Nox
pals.description: If you find Nox hair in your bedding, you should leave it where it lays and leave immediately. Picking it up is a one-way-ticket to a never ending night.

partnerSkill.name: Kuudere
partnerSkill.description: When activated, detects the location of nearby <Status_Keyword>Pal Effigies</>. {ReferenceMsgId_SearchAreaCoolTime}

pals.name: Flambelle
pals.description: When it starts crying, this Pal produces magma in place of tears. The magma that pours out is absorbed back into its body, causing it to get hotter and hotter. The more it cries, the stronger it becomes.

partnerSkill.name: Magma Tears
partnerSkill.description: While in party, recovers Health of the player and Party Pals by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</> per second outside of combat. (Does not stack) Sometimes drops fireorgan| style=|status_keyword when assigned to Ranch.

pals.name: Rooby
pals.description: Wild Rooby surprisingly never get sick. Eating one piece of charcoal a day, made by burning a branch, is the secret to its eternal health.

partnerSkill.name: Tiny Spark
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases Defense of Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Fire| style=|Elem_Fire) Pals by {Passive1_EffectValue1}%. (Does not stack) Sometimes drops fireorgan| style=|status_keyword when assigned to Ranch.

pals.name: Mau
pals.description: Its hard tail does not deteriorate even when cut off. Some believed these severed tails bring good luck, but for the innumerable Mau who were poached as a result, they were anything but.

partnerSkill.name: Gold Digger
partnerSkill.description: Sometimes digs up money| style=|status_keyword when assigned to Ranch.

pals.name: Mau Cryst
pals.description: Its crystalline tail is beautiful, but shatters when this Pal dies. Some believe it is good luck to raise them, so Mau Cryst in captivity are treated with great care.

partnerSkill.name: Icy Whispers
partnerSkill.description: Sometimes drops iceorgan| style=|status_keyword when assigned to Ranch.

pals.name: Rushoar
pals.description: Being an extremely aggressive Pal, it often picks fights before gauging its opponents' strength. Though small, its powerful charge can even send boulders flying.

partnerSkill.name: Hard Head
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While mounted, increases efficiency of destroying Stone by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>.

pals.name: Foxparks
pals.description: It is unskilled at controlling fire from the moment it is born and tends to choke on the flames it breathes unintentionally. Foxparks sneezes are one of the leading causes of forest fires.

partnerSkill.name: Huggy Fire
partnerSkill.description: When activated, equips to the player and transforms into a flamethrower. {ReferenceMsgId_DamageUp}

pals.name: Foxparks Cryst
pals.description: It is unskilled at controlling cold air from the moment it is born and tends to choke on the frost it breathes unintentionally. When Foxparks Cryst catches a cold, its nasal discharge freezes, making it difficult to breathe and causing it to panic.

partnerSkill.name: Huggy Frost
partnerSkill.description: When activated, equips to the player and attacks using frigid air. {ReferenceMsgId_DamageUp}

pals.name: Killamari
pals.description: It wraps itself around an enemy's head, sucking out their insides. Pal mummies are occasionally found, but these are in fact Killamari victims.

partnerSkill.name: Fried Squid
partnerSkill.description: While in party, modifies the performance of the equipped glider. Enables gentle floating while gliding for an extended time. {ReferenceMsgId_GriderPerformanceUp}

pals.name: Killamari Primo
pals.description: It sinks its fangs into the enemy’s neck, draining every last drop of blood. When two Killamari Primos latch onto each other, they become locked in a relentless struggle—each trying to suck the other dry until one withers away.

partnerSkill.name: Fried Killamari
partnerSkill.description: While in party, modifies the performance of the equipped glider. Enables gentle floating while gliding for an extended time. {ReferenceMsgId_GriderPerformanceUp}

pals.name: Fuddler
pals.description: Its large claws boast of diamond-like hardness. However, sharpening these claws consumes most of its energy, leading it to sometimes spending entire days doing nothing else.

partnerSkill.name: Mining Assistance
partnerSkill.description: While in party, improves player mining efficiency by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</> and reduces stone| style=|status_keyword weight by <Status_Up>{Passive2_EffectValue1}%</>. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Eikthyrdeer
pals.description: The one who possesses the most impressive antlers becomes the leader of the herd. If their antlers are broken, they become depressed and leave the herd never to be seen again.

partnerSkill.name: Guardian of the Forest
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Can perform a <Status_Keyword>double jump</> while mounted and increases lumbering efficiency by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>.

pals.name: Eikthyrdeer Terra
pals.description: The individual with the hardest horns becomes the leader. Once the horns are lost, so too is its leadership status. It leaves the herd amidst farewell glances and quietly returns to the earth.

partnerSkill.name: Guardian of the Golden Forest
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Can perform a <Status_Keyword>double jump</> while mounted. While at a base, increases the Unknown Status (COMMON_WORK_SUITABILITY_Deforest| style=|Status_Keyword) Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by <Status_Up>+{Passive1_EffectValue1}</> (Does not stack)

pals.name: Direhowl
pals.description: Long ago Direhowl would hunt alongside humans but over the years this bond faded.

partnerSkill.name: Direhowl Rider
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Moves slightly faster than most mounts. {ReferenceMsgId_RideSpeedUp}

pals.name: Caprity
pals.description: The shrub on this Pal's back produces berries as long as it is properly fed. It offers these berries to potential mates, and if the flavor is to their liking, romance blossoms.

partnerSkill.name: Berry Picker
partnerSkill.description: Sometimes drops berries| style=|status_keyword from its back when assigned to Ranch. While in party, restores <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}</> Pal’s Hunger to the Pal with the lowest Hunger every 5 minutes. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Caprity Noct
pals.description: The berries that grow on its back change flavor according to its emotions. The harsher the environment it grows in, the sweeter the berries become. This is why most Caprity Noct raised in captivity have never known love.

partnerSkill.name: Venom Picker
partnerSkill.description: Sometimes drops venom| style=|status_keyword from its back when assigned to Ranch. While in party, restores <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}</> Pal’s Hunger to the Pal with the lowest Hunger every 5 minutes. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Swee
pals.description: Crawling along the ground, it eats microscopic organic matter. After a while, it discharges any substances that provide no nutrition. By using it as a mop for cleaning, everyone wins!

partnerSkill.name: Fluffy
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases Attack and Defense of Unknown Character (MopKing| style=|Status_Keyword).

pals.name: Sweepa
pals.description: While hibernating, a large number of Swee hide within its voluminous body hair. The most ever recorded is 101.

partnerSkill.name: King of Fluff
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. This Pal's Attack and Defense increase by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</> for each Unknown Character (MopBaby| style=|Status_Keyword) in party.

pals.name: Turtacle
pals.description: To protect its fragile body, it developed an incredibly tough shell. Unfortunately, it's utterly defenseless underneath. Even a little tickle could knock it out cold.

partnerSkill.name: Spikey Carrier
partnerSkill.description: While in party, reduces copperore| style=|status_keyword weight by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Turtacle Terra
pals.description: To protect its fragile body, it developed an incredibly tough shell. With most of its senses concentrated in its limbs and shell, it can’t even tell if someone quietly touches its core.

partnerSkill.name: Shiny Hauler
partnerSkill.description: While in party, reduces weight of sulfur| style=|status_keyword and coal| style=|status_keyword by {Passive1_EffectValue1}%. Also improves player's and Pals' Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Earth| style=|Elem_Ground) damage to enemy weak points by {Passive1_EffectValue1}%. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Hangyu
pals.description: Its gigantic arms can rip apart even iron. As a particularly cruel form of execution, serious criminals would be strung up in a public square, and a Hangyu would tear the skin right from their bones.

partnerSkill.name: Flying Trapeze
partnerSkill.description: While in party, modifies the performance of the equipped glider. Enables slow ascension while gliding. {ReferenceMsgId_GriderPerformanceUp}

pals.name: Hangyu Cryst
pals.description: Its gigantic arms can tear through blocks of ice. There were times when great sinners were tied in the town square and had their hair torn out by Hangyu Cryst as a brutal form of public humiliation.

partnerSkill.name: Winter Trapeze
partnerSkill.description: While in party, modifies the performance of the equipped glider. Enables slow ascension while gliding. {ReferenceMsgId_GriderPerformanceUp}

pals.name: Woolipop
pals.description: Its entire body is 18,000 times sweeter than sugar. Carnivorous Pals lured by its scent will find themselves overwhelmed by sweetness and even pass out should they take a bite of this Pal.

partnerSkill.name: Candy Pop
partnerSkill.description: Sometimes drops sweet| style=|status_keyword when assigned to Ranch. While at a base, reduces Hunger depletion rate of Base Pals by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Woolipop Terra
pals.description: Its fur emits a sweet smell, but its meat is disgustingly bitter. Carnivorous Pals lured by its scent into taking a bite will find themselves overwhelmed by the foul taste and pass out.

partnerSkill.name: Bitter Pop
partnerSkill.description: Sometimes drops sweet_caramel| style=|status_keyword when assigned to Ranch. While at a base, reduces Hunger depletion rate of Base Pals by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Mozzarina
pals.description: Milk pours from this Pal like water from an open faucet, regardless of its gender. It's truly a mystery of life, although this mystery may be better left unsolved.

partnerSkill.name: Milk Maker
partnerSkill.description: Sometimes drops milk| style=|status_keyword when assigned to Ranch.

pals.name: Azurobe
pals.description: This Pal's white ribbon turns black if doused with impure water. Given its usefulness in detecting poison, this Pal was once overhunted. This past has left them bitter towards humanity.

partnerSkill.name: Waterwing Dance
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden to travel on water. While mounted, changes the player's attack type to Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Water| style=|Elem_Water) and increases Attack by {Passive2_EffectValue1}%. {ReferenceMsgId_SwimSpeedUp}

pals.name: Azurobe Cryst
pals.description: This Pal’s white ribbon continuously absorbs heat from its surroundings, yet its temperature remains curiously unchanged. This strange ability once made it a target of relentless hunting, leaving it with a deep mistrust of humans to this day.

partnerSkill.name: Icewing Dance
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden to travel on water. While mounted, changes the player’s attack type to Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Ice| style=|Elem_Ice) and increases Attack by {Passive2_EffectValue1}%. {ReferenceMsgId_SwimSpeedUp}

pals.name: Sparkit
pals.description: During the dry season, this Pal is always on the verge of blowing a fuse. Sparks can fly with even the slightest provocation, even amongst allies.

partnerSkill.name: Static Electricity
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases Attack of Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Electricity| style=|Elem_Electric) Pals by {Passive1_EffectValue1}%. (Does not stack) Sometimes drops electricorgan| style=|status_keyword when assigned to Ranch.

pals.name: Kelpsea
pals.description: Its personality changes depending on the quality of the water it was born into. Kelpsea born into polluted waters are generally ill-tempered and quickly become delinquents.

partnerSkill.name: Aqua Spout
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases Attack of Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Water| style=|Elem_Water) Pals by {Passive1_EffectValue1}%. (Does not stack) Sometimes drops palfluid| style=|status_keyword when assigned to Ranch.

pals.name: Kelpsea Ignis
pals.description: Its personality changes depending on the temperature of the water it was born into. Kelpsea born in warm waters generally have a passionate, motivated personality.

partnerSkill.name: Lava Spout
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases Attack of Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Fire| style=|Elem_Fire) Pals by {Passive1_EffectValue1}%. (Does not stack) Sometimes drops fireorgan| style=|status_keyword when assigned to Ranch.

pals.name: Ribbuny
pals.description: A Pal that's never without a bright smile. Occasionally, its tentacles get tied up in knots by Cattiva's pranks. During those moments, its expression turns demonic.

partnerSkill.name: Happy-Go-Lucky Bunny
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases Attack of Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Normal| style=|Elem_Neutral) Pals by {Passive1_EffectValue1}%. (Does not stack) While at a base, increases the Unknown Status (COMMON_WORK_SUITABILITY_Handcraft| style=|Status_Keyword) Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +{Passive2_EffectValue1}. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Ribbuny Botan
pals.description: Always wears a cheerful smile. Sometimes, thanks to Cattiva's pranks, they end up tangled in tentacles and have to fight their way out! Even in tough situations, they keep smiling cheerfully.

partnerSkill.name: Ground 'n' Pound
partnerSkill.description: While in party, improves player's and Pals' Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Leaf| style=|Elem_Grass) damage to enemy weak points by {Passive1_EffectValue1}%. (Does not stack) Increases efficiency by {Passive2_EffectValue1}% when working at a Weapon Workbench, Weapon Assembly Line, or other related facilities.

pals.name: Jelliette
pals.description: A Pal that closely resembles Jellroy. It’s very social, so when plans overlap, it asks its good friend Jellroy to go in its place. As thanks, one date.

partnerSkill.name: Jelliette Drop
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases items obtained from fishing by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>. While Jelliette and Jellroy are in your base, Jelliette's watering speed increases by <Status_Up>{Passive3_EffectValue1}%</>. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Jellroy
pals.description: A Pal that closely resembles Jelliette. It sometimes appears as a substitute when Jelliette is unavailable. Its acting is so flawless that no one ever notices the switch.

partnerSkill.name: Jellroy Drop
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases items obtained from salvaging by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>. While Jelliette and Jellroy are in your base, Jellroy's watering speed increases by <Status_Up>{Passive2_EffectValue1}%</>. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Amione
pals.description: If one disappears, another simply shows up to take its place, and life goes on like nothing happened. For Amione, companionship is everything.

partnerSkill.name: Magical Twin Powers
partnerSkill.description: While at a base, increases the Unknown Status (COMMON_WORK_SUITABILITY_Watering| style=|Status_Keyword) Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by <Status_Keyword>+{Passive1_EffectValue1}</>. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Gloopie
pals.description: Be sure to check your plans for the next day before falling asleep with this Pal. Its suction cups leave marks that look suspiciously like hickeys. One sleepy cuddle session could lead to some truly awkward misunderstandings.

partnerSkill.name: Sticky Princess
partnerSkill.description: While in party, the capture gauge decreases <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</> more slowly while the bars are not overlapping during the fishing minigame. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Gloopie Primo
pals.description: Be sure to check your plans for the next day before falling asleep with this Pal. Its suction cups leave marks that look suspiciously like bite marks. One sleepy cuddle session could lead to some truly unnecessary concern.

partnerSkill.name: Cephalo-Princess
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases Defense of Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Water| style=|Elem_Water) Pals by {Passive1_EffectValue1}%. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Galeclaw
pals.description: A Pal that can easily take flight even while grasping a human. It is, however, prone to letting go when tired, which has led to the sudden demise of more than a few souls.

partnerSkill.name: Galeclaw Glider
partnerSkill.description: While in party, modifies the performance of the equipped glider. Enables high-speed gliding and allows shooting with the right hand. {ReferenceMsgId_GriderPerformanceUp}

pals.name: Wispaw
pals.description: The ghostly hands behind it embody the souls of all humans who have raised its kind. Lately, they seem to have reached a unanimous consensus to dote on Wispaw.

partnerSkill.name: Death-Cheating Feline
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases the capture rate when awarded a <Status_Keyword>back bonus</>. (Does not stack) {ReferenceMsgId_CaptureRate}

pals.name: Nitewing
pals.description: It carries newborn Pals to its nest and raises them as a surrogate parent. Once the baby Pal has fattened up, it hunts them.

partnerSkill.name: Travel Companion
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. {ReferenceMsgId_RideSpeedUp}

pals.name: Tombat
pals.description: Often appears out of the blue to flaunt its prized wings in front of other Pals. Although this appears to be an intimidation tactic, the Pal seems to derive some kind of pleasure from the display.

partnerSkill.name: Ultrasonic Sensor
partnerSkill.description: When activated, uses ultrasonic waves to detect nearby <Status_Keyword>dungeons, treasure chests, and scrap</>. {ReferenceMsgId_SearchAreaCoolTime}

pals.name: Tocotoco
pals.description: A frightening Pal that produces exploding eggs. It often fires these eggs from its rear end as a form of defense, but when spent, the Pal itself explodes.

partnerSkill.name: Eggbomb Launcher
partnerSkill.description: When activated, equips to the player and transforms into an egg launcher. {ReferenceMsgId_DamageUp}

pals.name: Univolt
pals.description: It used to be considered an emissary of the Thunder God, and thus was not hunted by people. However, after witnesses observed one die from a lightning strike, its reverence faded, and it quite literally fell into the role of a workhorse.

partnerSkill.name: Swift Deity
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party, improves player's and Pals' Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Electricity| style=|Elem_Electric) damage to weak points by {Passive1_EffectValue1}%. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Univolt Cryst
pals.description: It used to be considered an emissary of the Winter God, and thus was not hunted by people. However, after witnesses observed one lose its footing on the ice, its reverence faded, and it quite literally slid into the role of a workhorse.

partnerSkill.name: Frigid Deity
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While mounted, changes the player’s attack type to Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Ice| style=|Elem_Ice) and increases Attack by {Passive2_EffectValue1}%.

pals.name: Gobfin
pals.description: Long ago, it was a giant and powerful aquatic Pal. However, as food became scarce, it evolved to live on land. Since walking requires much energy, it gradually became smaller and is now a small and puny Pal.

partnerSkill.name: Angry Shark
partnerSkill.description: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with WaterGun| style=|Status_Keyword. When this Pal uses WaterGun| style=|Status_Keyword, it has a <Status_Up>x{ActiveSkillMainValueByRank}</> damage multiplier. While in party, increases the player's Attack by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>.

pals.name: Gobfin Ignis
pals.description: Long ago, it was a giant and powerful aquatic Pal. However, as food became scarce, it evolved to live on land. Since walking burns many calories, it astonishingly awakened its power to control fire!

partnerSkill.name: Angry Shark
partnerSkill.description: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with FireSeed| style=|Status_Keyword. When this Pal uses FireSeed| style=|Status_Keyword, it has a <Status_Up>x{ActiveSkillMainValueByRank}</> damage multiplier. While in party, increases the player's Attack by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>.

pals.name: Loupmoon
pals.description: The horns on its head grow under the moonlight. It doesn't hate the sun, but its horns itch when sunlight hits them.

partnerSkill.name: Dark Gleam Strike
partnerSkill.description: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with Unique_Werewolf_Scratch| style=|Status_Keyword. When this Pal uses Unique_Werewolf_Scratch| style=|Status_Keyword, it has a <Status_Up>x{ActiveSkillMainValueByRank}</> damage multiplier. While in party, increases the player's <Status_Keyword>melee weapon attack speed</> by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Loupmoon Cryst
pals.description: The horns on its head are made of a mysterious ice that never melts. Shaved ice made by breaking off a horn is truly exquisite, but both the one who tries it and Loupmoon Cryst end up with a headache.

partnerSkill.name: Frozen Gleam Strike
partnerSkill.description: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with Unique_Werewolf_Ice_SnowScratch| style=|Status_Keyword. When this Pal uses Unique_Werewolf_Ice_SnowScratch| style=|Status_Keyword, it has a <Status_Up>x{ActiveSkillMainValueByRank}</> damage multiplier. While in party, increases the player's <Status_Keyword>melee weapon attack speed</> by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Cawgnito
pals.description: Long ago it freely soared the skies. After losing a contest with Galeclaw, it abandoned the skies, and now lives a secretive life in the dark of night.

partnerSkill.name: Eerie Nightstreaker
partnerSkill.description: When activated, grants <Status_Keyword>Night Vision</> to see in dark places. Activate again to turn off. Sometimes digs up bone| style=|status_keyword when assigned to Ranch.

pals.name: Arsox
pals.description: In ancient times, carnivorous Pals pursued them relentlessly. The absurd fury in the cries of Arsox transformed into a raging inferno, which has been passed on to this day.

partnerSkill.name: Warm Body
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party, the player gains <Status_Keyword>Cold Resistance</> <Status_Keyword>+2</>. (Does not stack) {ReferenceMsgId_RideSpeedUp}

pals.name: Muffly
pals.description: Its soft facial fluff softens any hit, but it cannot groom itself well nor scratch its itches, leaving it in a constant state of mild frustration.

partnerSkill.name: Fluffy Flutterer
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases the capture rate of Pals afflicted with Unknown Status (ADDITIONAL_EFFECT_Freeze| style=|Effect_Freeze). (Does not stack) {ReferenceMsgId_CaptureRate}

pals.name: Bristla
pals.description: This prickly Pal's thorns are highly poisonous. It is friendly with Cinnamoth and only smiles while a Cinnamoth is drinking its nectar.

partnerSkill.name: Princess Gaze
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases Attack of Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Leaf| style=|Elem_Grass) Pals by {Passive1_EffectValue1}%. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Cinnamoth
pals.description: Sniffing its scales produces a feeling of unparalleled euphoria. There was some effort to further regulate this byproduct, but the Free Pal Alliance have vehemently opposed these measures, putting a stop to them.

partnerSkill.name: Mysterious Scales
partnerSkill.description: When activated, attacks the targeted enemy with PoisonFog| style=|Status_Keyword. While at a base, increases the Unknown Status (COMMON_WORK_SUITABILITY_MonsterFarm| style=|Status_Keyword) Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by <Status_Keyword>+{Passive1_EffectValue1}</>. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Puffolt
pals.description: Its fluffy fur absorbs tremendous amounts of water when soaked. Shaking it dry releases a powerful electrical discharge, making bath time together a serious gamble.

partnerSkill.name: Crackle Booster
partnerSkill.description: While at a base, increases the Unknown Status (COMMON_WORK_SUITABILITY_GenerateElectricity| style=|Status_Keyword) Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by <Status_Keyword>+{Passive1_EffectValue1}</>. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Elphidran
pals.description: It possesses a demeanor as pure as its appearance suggests. Perhaps because of this, it is sometimes unable to discern good from evil, often allowing wrongdoers to take advantage of it.

partnerSkill.name: Amicable Holy Dragon
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While flying, Movement Speed is increased. While in party, Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Dark| style=|Elem_Dark) Pals drop {Passive1_EffectValue1}% more items when defeated. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Elphidran Aqua
pals.description: It possesses a demeanor as pure as its appearance suggests. Perhaps because of this, it harbors no ill will in any of its actions and is indifferent even after killing someone.

partnerSkill.name: Amicable Water Dragon
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While flying, Movement Speed is increased. While in party, player and party Pals take {Passive1_EffectValue1}% less Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Fire| style=|Elem_Fire) damage and are immune to Unknown Status (ADDITIONAL_EFFECT_Burn| style=|Effect_Burn). (Does not stack)

pals.name: Vanwyrm
pals.description: The melodies of a flute made from the exoskeleton of a Vanwyrm are said to cross whole mountain ranges. In ages past, such flutes were used to signal an attack.

partnerSkill.name: Aerial Marauder
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While in party, increases damage player deals to enemy weak points by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Vanwyrm Cryst
pals.description: The melodies of a flute made from the exoskeleton of a Vanwyrm Cryst are said to cross whole mountain ranges. In ages past, such flutes were used to signal victory in battle.

partnerSkill.name: Aerial Marauder
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While in party, increases damage player deals to enemy weak points by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Felbat
pals.description: Attacking from the shadows, this Pal traps its prey within its cloak-like wings. It's probably best not to know what happens within them, or why the inside of its wings are stained red.

partnerSkill.name: Life Steal
partnerSkill.description: While fighting together, grants the player and Felbat a life steal effect that <Status_Keyword>restores</> <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</> of damage dealt as Unknown Status (COMMON_STATUS_HP| style=|Status_Keyword).

pals.name: Vaelet
pals.description: The castle was filled with the king's favorite flowers. A great battle ensued, and flames approached the castle. Amidst the chaos, the spirit of a flower appeared. - From the fairy tale, |The King's Flower.|

partnerSkill.name: Purification of Gaia
partnerSkill.description: While in party, Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Earth| style=|Elem_Ground) Pals drop {Passive1_EffectValue1}% more items when defeated. (Does not stack) Sometimes drops various seeds when assigned to Ranch.

pals.name: Beegarde
pals.description: A servant that pledges loyalty to Elizabee. Any that cause harm to the queen are immediately expelled from the hive. It will gladly give its life to protect its queen.

partnerSkill.name: Worker Bee
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases Unknown Character (QueenBee| style=|Status_Keyword)'s Attack. Sometimes drops honey| style=|status_keyword when assigned to Ranch.

pals.name: Elizabee
pals.description: A chosen queen to rule over Beegardes. There is a never ending stream of servants willing to work themselves to death for the pleasure of serving their queen.

partnerSkill.name: Queen Bee Command
partnerSkill.description: This Pal's Attack increases by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</> for each Unknown Character (SoldierBee| style=|Status_Keyword) in party.

pals.name: Lovander
pals.description: Seeking a night of love, it is always chasing someone around. At first it only showed interest in other Pals, but in recent years even humans have become the target of its debauchery.

partnerSkill.name: Heart Drain
partnerSkill.description: While fighting together, grants the player and Lovander a life steal effect that <Status_Keyword>restores</> <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</> of damage dealt as Unknown Status (COMMON_STATUS_HP| style=|Status_Keyword).

pals.name: Grintale
pals.description: Grintale's eyes light up the moment anyone enters its territory. This is no figure of speech—its eyes literally light up.

partnerSkill.name: Glaring Cat's Eye
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party, picking up a <Status_Keyword>Pal Egg</> has a <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</> chance of receiving one extra. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Tarantriss
pals.description: Extremely sticky and clingy. The more it's resisted, the more tenacious it becomes. Such is its |personality.|

partnerSkill.name: Tarantriss’ Web
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Can <Status_Keyword>double jump</> while mounted. Additionally, can shoot spider web to grapple and move at high speed. {ReferenceMsgId_RideSpeedUp}

pals.name: Polapup
pals.description: Among Polapups, the fastest slider on the snow earns the highest respect. Sometimes, a too-forceful leap sends one tumbling from the sky— a common sight during territorial season. Forecast: clear skies with a chance of flying Polapups.

partnerSkill.name: Rider of the Snowy Mountain
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Movement Speed is increased by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</> while mounted <Status_Keyword>on snow</>. Can also slide quickly down slopes.

pals.name: Polapup Terra
pals.description: Among Polapup Terras, the fastest slider on the snow earns the highest respect. Sometimes, a too-forceful leap leaves one buried in the snow— a common sight during particularly competitive seasons. Traffic forecast: heavy Polapup Terra congestion.

partnerSkill.name: Snowy Mountain Slider
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Movement Speed is increased by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</> while mounted <Status_Keyword>on snow</>. Can also slide quickly down slopes. While it starts out slow, the top speed it can hit while sliding is no joke.

pals.name: Leezpunk
pals.description: A Pal that always takes great care to maintain a stylish stance. Always on the hunt for the coolest poses, if given a mirror it will spend all day posing in front of it.

partnerSkill.name: Too Cool to be Seen
partnerSkill.description: When activated, Leezpunk and the player become <Status_Keyword>invisible</>, making them undetectable to enemies for <Status_Up>{ActiveSkillOverWriteEffectTime}</> seconds. {ReferenceMsgId_CooldownReduction}

pals.name: Leezpunk Ignis
pals.description: A Pal that has an unusual obsession with their standing posture. Always in search of the hottest pose, this Pal's owner is constantly presented with fervent stances.

partnerSkill.name: Too Cool to be Seen
partnerSkill.description: When activated, Leezpunk Ignis and the player become <Status_Keyword>invisible</>, making them undetectable to enemies for <Status_Up>{ActiveSkillOverWriteEffectTime}</> seconds. {ReferenceMsgId_CooldownReduction}

pals.name: Gorirat
pals.description: It beats the ground rhythmically to communicate with its comrades. The meaning of each rhythm differs by troop, but the distinction between them is still largely unknown.

partnerSkill.name: Full-Power Gorilla Mode
partnerSkill.description: When activated, unleashes a primal fury that increases Gorirat's Attack by <Status_Up>{ReferencePassive1_EffectValue1}%</> for a limited time.

pals.name: Gorirat Terra
pals.description: It beats the ground rhythmically to communicate with its comrades. Stronger than Gorirat, if every Gorirat Terra hit the ground at the same time, the island would sink in 1 second.

partnerSkill.name: Full-Power Gorilla Pound
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases the player's climbing speed by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Surfent
pals.description: Its hydrodynamic form is well suited for activities on water. Poachers often catch them and use them in place of surfboards.

partnerSkill.name: Swift Swimmer
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden to travel on water. Sometimes drops leather| style=|status_keyword when assigned to Ranch. {ReferenceMsgId_RideSpeedUp}

pals.name: Surfent Terra
pals.description: Its aerodynamic form is well suited for activities on sand. Poachers often catch them and use them in place of surfboards.

partnerSkill.name: Sand Swimmer
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party, the player's attacks inflict Unknown Status (ADDITIONAL_EFFECT_Muddy| style=|Effect_Muddy) <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}</>. (Does not stack) {ReferenceMsgId_RideSpeedUp}

pals.name: Robinquill
pals.description: A Pal that is very similar to humans who hunt and live in the forests. It may prove to be a key for understanding what Pals are and how they diverged from humans in the distant past.

partnerSkill.name: Grounded Archer
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases the player's <Status_Keyword>bow damage</> by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Robinquill Terra
pals.description: A Pal that is very similar to humans who hunt and live in the rocky areas. When Robinquill Terra bones are found in ruins, there are always human bones found nearby as well.

partnerSkill.name: Master Archer
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases the player's <Status_Keyword>bow charge speed</> by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Flopie
pals.description: It prefers places that have an abundance of vegetation, but hay fever has apparently become a problem for Flopie as of late.

partnerSkill.name: Helper Bunny
partnerSkill.description: While in party, appears near the player. Automatically picks up nearby items. {ReferenceMsgId_ItemCollectRangeUp}

pals.name: Wixen
pals.description: With the power of light, it produces arcane phenomena. It prefers to eat food well-done and is particularly hostile towards Katress.

partnerSkill.name: Lord Fox
partnerSkill.description: When activated, Wixen changes the player's attack type to Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Fire| style=|Elem_Fire) and increases Attack by {ReferencePassive1_EffectValue1}%.

pals.name: Wixen Noct
pals.description: Due to its upbringing, it no longer cares about whether its food is cooked enough. This Pal stopped worrying about those details, and just prefers its food to be as sweet as possible. Not on good terms with Katress Ignis.

partnerSkill.name: Black Fox Lord
partnerSkill.description: When activated, Wixen Noct changes the player's attack type to Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Dark| style=|Elem_Dark) and increases Attack by {ReferencePassive1_EffectValue1}%.

pals.name: Katress
pals.description: With the power of shadows, it produces arcane phenomena. It prefers to eat food raw and is particularly hostile towards Wixen.

partnerSkill.name: Mystical Black Magic
partnerSkill.description: While in party, Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Normal| style=|Elem_Neutral) Pals drop {Passive1_EffectValue1}% more items when defeated. Also has a {Passive2_EffectValue1}% chance to prevent Pal Sphere consumption when thrown. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Katress Ignis
pals.description: Due to its upbringing, it no longer cares about whether its food is raw enough. This Pal stopped worrying about those details, and just prefers its food to be as spicy as possible. Not on good terms with Wixen Noct.

partnerSkill.name: Blazing Black Magic
partnerSkill.description: While at a base, increases the Unknown Status (COMMON_WORK_SUITABILITY_EmitFlame| style=|Status_Keyword) Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by <Status_Keyword>+{Passive1_EffectValue1}</>. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Helzephyr
pals.description: It calls forth lightning from the depths of hell. Those who dies from Helzephyr's lightning are sure to have their soul sent to the underworld.

partnerSkill.name: Wings of Death
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While mounted, changes the player’s attack type to Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Dark| style=|Elem_Dark) and increases Attack by {Passive2_EffectValue1}%.

pals.name: Helzephyr Lux
pals.description: It calls forth lightning from the depths of hell. While considered a subspecies of Helzephyr, there's a theory that suggests Helzephyr Lux, struck by lightning from hell, will transform into Helzephyr.

partnerSkill.name: Wings of Thunder
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While mounted, changes the player’s attack type to Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Electricity| style=|Elem_Electric) and increases Attack by {Passive2_EffectValue1}%.

pals.name: Elgrove
pals.description: The leaf on its horn cannot be removed, no matter how hard it is pulled. When the leaf falls on its own, Elgrove accepts its time has come.

partnerSkill.name: Mother Nature's Menace
partnerSkill.description: When activated, Elgrove changes the player's attack type to Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Leaf| style=|Elem_Grass) and increases Attack by {ReferencePassive1_EffectValue1}%.

pals.name: Elgrove Cryst
pals.description: Its frozen horn stays solid through its life. When water begins to drip from this ice, Elgrove Cryst feels the chill of its own life slipping away.

partnerSkill.name: Father Winter's Threat
partnerSkill.description: While in party, grants the player the ability to Unknown Status (ADDITIONAL_EFFECT_Freeze| style=|Effect_Freeze) enemies afflicted with Unknown Status (ADDITIONAL_EFFECT_Wetness| style=|Effect_Wetness) in one strike.

pals.name: Lunaris
pals.description: It can control those who carelessly stare into its eyes. Those seen with a Lunaris are in its mind, simply under its control.

partnerSkill.name: Antigravity
partnerSkill.description: While in party, spheres <Status_Keyword>home in</> on Pals, and carrying capacity increases by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}</>. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Fenglope
pals.description: In ages past, its beautiful visage was a common sight in paintings. As time passed, its beautiful pelt and antlers were often seen in works of art.

partnerSkill.name: Wind and Clouds
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Can <Status_Keyword>double jump</> while mounted. {ReferenceMsgId_RideSpeedUp}

pals.name: Fenglope Lux
pals.description: In ages past, it was believed that drawing a picture of Fenglope Lux would result in being struck down by lightning. As time passes, artworks depicting Fenglope Lux became revered as charms to ward off lightning, making them a common presence.

partnerSkill.name: Stormcloud
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Can double jump while mounted. While in party, Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Water| style=|Elem_Water) Pals drop {Passive1_EffectValue1}% more items when defeated. (Does not stack) {ReferenceMsgId_RideSpeedUp}

pals.name: Dinossom
pals.description: A Pal who once angered cannot be pacified. It rages on and on like an inferno. The phrase |step on a Dinossom's tail| has come to mean enraging someone.

partnerSkill.name: Fragrant Dragon
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party, increase Defense of Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Dragon| style=|Elem_Dragon) Pals by {Passive1_EffectValue1}%. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Dinossom Lux
pals.description: Though struck by lightning, it lives on. The phrase |struck by a Dinossom Lux's bolt| has come to mean narrowly escaping death.

partnerSkill.name: Thunder Dragon
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party, increases Defense of Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Electricity| style=|Elem_Electric) Pals by {Passive1_EffectValue1}%. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Bushi
pals.description: Its body becomes a blade upon death, to be taken up by the next generation. If someone other than a Bushi wields this blade, the soul within torments them until they are driven mad.

partnerSkill.name: Brandish Blade
partnerSkill.description: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with Unique_Ronin_Iai| style=|Status_Keyword. When this Pal uses Unique_Ronin_Iai| style=|Status_Keyword, it has a <Status_Up>x{ActiveSkillMainValueByRank}</> damage multiplier.

pals.name: Bushi Noct
pals.description: Its body becomes a blade upon death, to be taken up by the next generation. If the Bushi who inherits it has a weak heart, the voices of the dead will drive it mad. The madness turns it into Bushi Noct that endlessly wanders.

partnerSkill.name: Void Blade
partnerSkill.description: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with Unique_Ronin_Iai| style=|Status_Keyword. When this Pal uses Unique_Ronin_Iai| style=|Status_Keyword, it has a <Status_Up>x{ActiveSkillMainValueByRank}</> damage multiplier. While in party, increases the player's <Status_Keyword>melee weapon damage</> by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</> but only when not in combat. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Munchill
pals.description: The inside of its mouth stays pleasantly cold, making it a natural fridge when closed. Its saliva contains enzymes that prevent food from rotting. Thus, it can serve as a food locker for humans— whether it is sanitary or not is another matter entirely.

partnerSkill.name: Icy Maw
partnerSkill.description: While in party, reduces the weight of ingredient and food by {Passive1_EffectValue1}%. When paired with another Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Ice| style=|Elem_Ice) Pal, their Rot Speed also reduces by {Passive2_EffectValue1}%. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Mammorest
pals.description: The vegetation on its back varies between individuals. There is a long history of appreciating this veritable garden of a Pal, and there are even Mammorest pruning specialists.

partnerSkill.name: Gaia Crusher
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While mounted, increases logging efficiency by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</> and mining efficiency by <Status_Up>{Passive2_EffectValue1}%</>.

pals.name: Mammorest Cryst
pals.description: The vegetation on its back varies between individuals. There was a time when seeds of presumed extinct plants were found still frozen on the back of a Mammorest Cryst.

partnerSkill.name: Ice Crusher
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While mounted, increases logging efficiency by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</> and mining efficiency by <Status_Up>{Passive2_EffectValue1}%</>.

pals.name: Finsider
pals.description: It looks like something is peeking out from inside a costume, but even if you reach inside, there’s nothing there. In fact, you can keep reaching deeper and deeper. Perhaps the universe itself lies within.

partnerSkill.name: Water Gun
partnerSkill.description: When activated, Finsider changes the player's attack type to Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Water| style=|Elem_Water) and increases Attack by {ReferencePassive1_EffectValue1}%.

pals.name: Finsider Ignis
pals.description: Even if you reach into its mouth, there’s nothing inside—it just keeps going. Thinking it might be an interdimensional space, one researcher tried climbing in like a sleeping bag. But when the gag reflex kicked in, they realized... it’s definitely part of the creature’s body.

partnerSkill.name: Ember Chamber
partnerSkill.description: While in party, Finsider Ignis helps carry supplies, reducing the weight of weapons in your inventory by {Passive1_EffectValue1}%. Also improves player's and Pals' Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Fire| style=|Elem_Fire) damage to enemy weak points by {Passive2_EffectValue1}%. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Petallia
pals.description: A Pal that transforms into a massive plant when at the end of its life. Once every ten years, a beautiful flower blooms and a new Petallia is born.

partnerSkill.name: Blessing of the Flower Spirit
partnerSkill.description: When activated, soothing blossoms restore the player's Health by <Status_Up>{ActiveSkillMainValueByRank}%</>. While at a base, increases the Unknown Status (COMMON_WORK_SUITABILITY_Seeding| style=|Status_Keyword) Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by <Status_Keyword>+{Passive1_EffectValue1}</>. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Petallia Ignis
pals.description: A Pal that burns away into a pile of ash upon the end of its life. The surrounding soil becomes incredibly fertile, allowing an abundance of vegetation to thrive for the following decade.

partnerSkill.name: Passion of the Flower Spirit
partnerSkill.description: When activated, soothing blossoms restore the player's Health by {ActiveSkillMainValueByRank}%. While in party, player and party Pals take {Passive1_EffectValue1}% less Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Leaf| style=|Elem_Grass) damage, and are immune to Unknown Status (ADDITIONAL_EFFECT_IvyCling| style=|Effect_IvyCling). (Does not stack)

pals.name: Leafan
pals.description: To hone the martial art passed down through a single bloodline: Daily training is the only way! Being distracted by romance? Unthinkable! Daily discipline is the only way! The time has come! Shoot my shot! Instant rejection, that’s all there is! The techniques of love were never passed down... Lingering regret, that’s all there is!

partnerSkill.name: Selfless Discipline
partnerSkill.description: This Pal's Attack and Defense increase by {Passive1_EffectValue1}% for each other Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Leaf| style=|Elem_Grass) Pal in your party.

pals.name: Incineram
pals.description: In the dark of night, this Pal snatches prey to bring back to its territory. What happens to those poor souls afterwards isn't too hard to imagine.

partnerSkill.name: Flameclaw Hunter
partnerSkill.description: When activated, attacks the targeted enemy with Unique_Baphomet_SwallowKite| style=|Status_Keyword. When this Pal uses Unique_Baphomet_SwallowKite| style=|Status_Keyword, it has a <Status_Up>x{ActiveSkillMainValueByRank}</> damage multiplier.

pals.name: Incineram Noct
pals.description: It specifically targets baby Pals, taking them back to its domain. One can only imagine the profound despair of a parent whose child has been taken away.

partnerSkill.name: Darkclaw Hunter
partnerSkill.description: When activated, attacks the targeted enemy with Unique_Baphomet_Dark_DarkKite| style=|Status_Keyword. When this Pal uses Unique_Baphomet_Dark_DarkKite| style=|Status_Keyword, it has a <Status_Up>x{ActiveSkillMainValueByRank}</> damage multiplier.

pals.name: Dazzi
pals.description: Often kind to lonely Pals. However, the moment a Pal mistakes this for actual friendship, it seizes the opportunity to blast them with a thunderbolt.

partnerSkill.name: Lady of Lightning
partnerSkill.description: While in party, appears near the player. Attacks hostile enemies with Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Electricity| style=|Elem_Electric) bolts. These bolts will not reduce the target's Health below 1. {ReferenceMsgId_Funnel}

pals.name: Dazzi Noct
pals.description: Often kind to lonely Pals, it plots to lure them into dropping their guard before striking them down. Yet, unable to find the right moment, it ends up making friends with them instead.

partnerSkill.name: Lady of Dark Lightning
partnerSkill.description: While in party, appears near the player. Attacks hostile enemies with Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Dark| style=|Elem_Dark) bolts. These bolts will not reduce the target's Health below 1. {ReferenceMsgId_Funnel}

pals.name: Pyrin
pals.description: Its entire body has evolved into a highly efficient radiator, gifting it with astounding stamina. If someone rides it, this Pal takes caution not to burn them.

partnerSkill.name: Red Hare
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While mounted, changes the player’s attack type to Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Fire| style=|Elem_Fire) and increases Attack by {Passive2_EffectValue1}%.

pals.name: Pyrin Noct
pals.description: It burns mysterious dark matter as energy and expels the remaining particles from its body. If someone rides it, they should take care so as not to gallop down the path of darkness.

partnerSkill.name: Black Hare
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While mounted, changes the player’s attack type toUnknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Dark| style=|Elem_Dark) and increases Attack by {Passive2_EffectValue1}%.

pals.name: Relaxaurus
pals.description: Contrary to its blasé appearance, it's quite ferocious. It perceives everything in its sight as prey and will stop at nothing to devour it.

partnerSkill.name: Hungry Missile
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Can rapidly fire a missile launcher while mounted. {ReferenceMsgId_DamageUp}

pals.name: Relaxaurus Lux
pals.description: One day, Relaxaurus had an idea. Maybe it was about time for a change. Just then, an electric shock raced through its body!

partnerSkill.name: Missile Party
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Can rapidly fire a missile launcher while mounted. {ReferenceMsgId_DamageUp}

pals.name: Foxcicle
pals.description: On nights when the aurora is visible, it looks up towards the sky and begins to howl a beautiful song. This does, however, leave it vulnerable to attacks from enemies.

partnerSkill.name: Aurora Guide
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases Attack of Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Ice| style=|Elem_Ice) Pals by {Passive1_EffectValue1}%. (Does not stack) Sometimes drops iceorgan| style=|status_keyword when assigned to Ranch.

pals.name: Beakon
pals.description: Some think it is a related species to Ragnahawk, but there is in fact no connection. Using its sharp beak, it descends on its prey in a quick motion that resembles a bolt of lightning.

partnerSkill.name: Thunderous
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While mounted, changes the player's attack type to Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Electricity| style=|Elem_Electric) and increases Attack by {Passive3_EffectValue1}%. This Pal’s Movement Speed increases by {Passive1_EffectValue1}% for each other Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Electricity| style=|Elem_Electric) Pal in your party. (Excluding Beakon)

pals.name: Beakon Cryst
pals.description: Perfectly adapted to colder environments, it hardly feels the cold despite its slender form. Its diving plunge carries tremendous force, as if a giant icicle were dropping straight from the sky.

partnerSkill.name: Coldsnap
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While mounted, changes the player's attack type to Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Ice| style=|Elem_Ice) and increases Attack by {Passive3_EffectValue1}%. This Pal’s Movement Speed increases by {Passive1_EffectValue1}% for each other Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Ice| style=|Elem_Ice) Pal in your party. (Excluding Beakon Cryst)

pals.name: Ghangler
pals.description: With its shining lure, it illuminates the darkness. The wandering Pals drawn in by the light stand no chance of escape once spotted by Ghangler. No matter how far, it will keep guiding them until they get home safe and sound.

partnerSkill.name: Master of Darkness
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden to travel on water. This Pal’s Movement Speed increases by {Passive1_EffectValue1}% for each other Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Dark| style=|Elem_Dark) or Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Water| style=|Elem_Water) Pal in your party. (Excluding Ghangler)

pals.name: Ghangler Ignis
pals.description: Its blazing lure doubles as a grill for roasting prey. Drawn in by the delicious aroma, Pals have no hope of escape once Ghangler Ignis sets its sights on them. In the end, they’re treated to a hearty meal—until everyone’s full.

partnerSkill.name: Abyssal Celebrity Chef
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden to travel on water. This Pal’s Movement Speed increases by {Passive1_EffectValue1}% for each other Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Fire| style=|Elem_Fire) or Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Water| style=|Elem_Water) Pal in your party. (Excluding Ghangler Ignis)

pals.name: Rayhound
pals.description: At full speed, it could be mistaken for a bolt of lightning. When two Rayhounds collide, a thunderous roar echoes through the air.

partnerSkill.name: Lightning Shepherd
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Can perform a double jump while mounted. This Pal’s Movement Speed increases by {Passive1_EffectValue1}% for each other Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Electricity| style=|Elem_Electric) Pal in your party. (Excluding Rayhound)

pals.name: Rayhound Cryst
pals.description: Sprinting across the tundra at full speed kicks up a blinding blizzard, leading to constant Rayhound Cryst collisions due to zero visibility.

partnerSkill.name: Snow Shepherd
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Can perform a double jump while mounted. While in party, increases Defense of Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Ice| style=|Elem_Ice) Pals by {Passive1_EffectValue1}%. (Does not stack) {ReferenceMsgId_RideSpeedUp}

pals.name: Menasting
pals.description: Being made of pure energy, its insides are completely hollow. This Pal crams still-living prey into its hollow body, where it absorbs them. Hellish screams of pain can often be heard coming from inside this Pal.

partnerSkill.name: Steel Scorpion
partnerSkill.description: While in party, player's Defense increases by {Passive2_EffectValue1}%, and Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Electricity| style=|Elem_Electric) Pals drop {Passive1_EffectValue1}% more items when defeated. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Menasting Terra
pals.description: Being made of pure energy, its insides are completely hollow. It stuffs earth and minerals into its outer shell, achieving overwhelming mass. Those who are struck by it can only let out hellish groans.

partnerSkill.name: Golden Scorpion
partnerSkill.description: While in party, player's Defense increases by {Passive2_EffectValue1}%, and Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Electricity| style=|Elem_Electric) Pals drop {Passive1_EffectValue1}% more items when defeated. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Needoll
pals.description: Its spikes react to its emotions. A dearly cherished Needoll is something one may instinctively want to embrace. But more often than not, it ends in a tragic accident.

partnerSkill.name: Hug Me Please
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases player's and Pals' damage to enemies afflicted with Unknown Status (ADDITIONAL_EFFECT_IvyCling| style=|Effect_IvyCling) by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Needoll Noct
pals.description: Its spikes react to its emotions. A well-loved Needoll Noct clings to its owner, but accepting that love means accepting the pain too.

partnerSkill.name: Hug You So Much
partnerSkill.description: While in party, the player's attacks inflict Unknown Status (ADDITIONAL_EFFECT_IvyCling| style=|Effect_IvyCling) <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}</>. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Reindrix
pals.description: Its transparent cerulean antlers glow with the cold of absolute zero. Any who touch them with their bare hands are instantly frozen and smashed to pieces.

partnerSkill.name: Cool Body
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party, the player gains <Status_Keyword>Heat Resistance</> <Status_Keyword>+2</>. (Does not stack) {ReferenceMsgId_RideSpeedUp}

pals.name: Mossanda
pals.description: A Pal so powerful it's hard to believe. In one experiment, this Pal tore through 3,000 sheets of paper at once! It's only by some miracle that this Pal isn't a meat-eater.

partnerSkill.name: Grenadier Panda
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Can rapidly fire a grenade launcher while mounted. {ReferenceMsgId_DamageUp}

pals.name: Mossanda Lux
pals.description: A Pal whose power is truly shocking. By altering the electrical currents in its body, this Pal's been able to overload its own strength. When it comes to sheer power, this Pal may be top of the list.

partnerSkill.name: Grenadier Panda
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Can rapidly fire a grenade launcher while mounted. {ReferenceMsgId_DamageUp}

pals.name: Chillet
pals.description: It can curl up its body and roll around at extremely high speeds. Long ago, people would tie bags of milk to domesticated Chillet as they grazed to produce butter using this spinning force.

partnerSkill.name: Wriggling Weasel
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While mounted, changes the player’s attack type to Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Dragon| style=|Elem_Dragon) and increases Attack by {Passive2_EffectValue1}%.

pals.name: Chillet Ignis
pals.description: It can curl up its body and roll around so fast that sparks fly. Sparks also fly when it feels excited. If you stroke it too much, this pal will get fired up, literally!

partnerSkill.name: Sparkling Weasel
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While mounted, changes the player’s attack type to Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Fire| style=|Elem_Fire) and increases Attack by {Passive2_EffectValue1}%.

pals.name: Ragnahawk
pals.description: Some think it is a related species to Beakon, but there is in fact no connection. It mainly eats rocks, and after many long years its beak and head have hardened to accommodate this diet.

partnerSkill.name: Flame Wing
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While mounted, changes the player’s attack type to Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Fire| style=|Elem_Fire) and increases Attack by {Passive2_EffectValue1}%.

pals.name: Moldron
pals.description: In a healthy individual, the lava on its back flows smoothly. However, a poor lifestyle will gradually worsen its circulation, eventually causing a lava clog that results in a sudden, massive explosion.

partnerSkill.name: Magma Overload
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a mount. This Pal's Attack increases by {Passive1_EffectValue1}% for each other Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Fire| style=|Elem_Fire) or Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Earth| style=|Elem_Ground) Pal in your party.

pals.name: Moldron Cryst
pals.description: In a healthy individual, the substance flowing along its back maintains a stable temperature. However, if its heartbeat quickens, the temperature destabilizes, eventually triggering vaporization or crystallization that results in a sudden, abrupt death from shock.

partnerSkill.name: Ice Overload
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party, improves player's and Pals' Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Ice| style=|Elem_Ice) damage to enemy weak points by {Passive1_EffectValue1}%. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Palumba
pals.description: Disrupts enemies’ rhythm with a signature dance. In turf battles, the first to fall in sync with the other’s rhythm loses. Courtship, boredom, battle—it all comes down to dance! Now then, what could a dance aimed at a human possibly mean?

partnerSkill.name: Samba Step
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Movement Speed is increased by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</> while mounted <Status_Keyword>on grass</>.

pals.name: Digtoise
pals.description: A Digtoise possessing the strongest shell and the only drill capable of piercing it, ponders the contradictions of the world in the popular children's tale, |Digtoise's Fable|.

partnerSkill.name: Drill Crusher
partnerSkill.description: When activated, enters the Unique_DrillGame_ShellAttack| style=|Status_Keyword state. Follows the player while spinning, increasing ore mining efficiency by <Status_Up>{ReferencePassive1_EffectValue1}%</>.

pals.name: Broncherry
pals.description: Its scent drastically changes before and after pairing. It exudes a pleasing aroma after finding a partner, which is called the |Fragrance of First Love.|

partnerSkill.name: Love's First Blossom
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party, Pal Eggs you pick up have a <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</> chance of becoming an Alpha Pal Egg. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Broncherry Aqua
pals.description: Its scent drastically changes before and after pairing. It exudes a pleasing aroma before finding a partner, which is called the |Perfume of Purity.|

partnerSkill.name: Purity's Full Bloom
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party, Pal Eggs you pick up have a <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</> chance of becoming an Alpha Pal Egg. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Dumud
pals.description: When too relaxed, its reaction time drastically declines. Even if it were sliced from head to tail, it probably wouldn't even realize that it should be dead until the next morning.

partnerSkill.name: Soil Improver
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases Attack of Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Earth| style=|Elem_Ground) Pals by {Passive1_EffectValue1}%. (Does not stack) Sometimes drops paloil| style=|status_keyword when assigned to Ranch.

pals.name: Dumud Gild
pals.description: Its body reflects light with astounding clarity. Even more shocking, its reflexes are somehow even slower than Dumud.

partnerSkill.name: Golden Harvest
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases amount of Gold Coin dropped by enemies by <Status_Up>+{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>. Sometimes drops paloil| style=|status_keyword when assigned to Ranch, with a small chance to drop money| style=|status_keyword. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Braloha
pals.description: Its breath carries a miraculous, pollen-like substance that pollinates any plant it touches. For plant-based Pals, being near it can be a bit… complicated.

partnerSkill.name: Balmy Weather
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in your base, increases the egg production speed of Pals assigned to Breeding Farm by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Kitsun
pals.description: Despite its appearance, Kitsun is extremely sensitive and will flee into a cave when spooked. Long ago, it was considered an ill omen if one ran away from you.

partnerSkill.name: Wolf of the Sun
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party, player and party Pals take {Passive1_EffectValue1}% less Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Ice| style=|Elem_Ice) damage and are immune to Unknown Status (ADDITIONAL_EFFECT_Freeze| style=|Effect_Freeze). (Does not stack) {ReferenceMsgId_RideSpeedUp}

pals.name: Kitsun Noct
pals.description: Despite its appearance, Kitsun Noct is extremely sensitive and will flee into a cave when spooked. It has become quite gloomy from being a shut-in for too long.

partnerSkill.name: Gloomhowl
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party, player and party Pals take {Passive1_EffectValue1}% less Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Dark| style=|Elem_Dark) damage and are immune to Unknown Status (ADDITIONAL_EFFECT_Darkness| style=|Effect_Darkness). (Does not stack) {ReferenceMsgId_RideSpeedUp}

pals.name: Blazehowl
pals.description: While it prefers raw meat, it always ends up eating well-done meat. This is due to its blistering claws, which it uses as its weapon—it simply doesn't realize its prey gets burned to a crisp.

partnerSkill.name: Hellflame Lion
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party, Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Leaf| style=|Elem_Grass) Pals drop {Passive1_EffectValue1}% more items when defeated. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Blazehowl Noct
pals.description: While it prefers raw meat, it always ends up eating tainted meat. This is due to its dark claws, which it uses as its weapon—it simply doesn't realize its prey gets cursed.

partnerSkill.name: Darkflame Lion
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party, Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Normal| style=|Elem_Neutral) Pals drop {Passive1_EffectValue1}% more items when defeated. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Warsect
pals.description: The ultra-hard armor surrounding its body is extremely strong and heat resistant. Even a napalm blast would hardly leave a scratch.

partnerSkill.name: Cast-Iron Shell
partnerSkill.description: While in your party, <Status_Keyword>generates a barrier</> around the player after 5 melee hits are landed within <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1} seconds</>. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Warsect Terra
pals.description: The ultra-hard armor surrounding its body is extremely strong and heat resistant. It doesn't flinch even if a Mammorest steps on it.

partnerSkill.name: Fullmetal Shell
partnerSkill.description: While in your party, <Status_Keyword>generates a barrier</> around the player after 5 melee hits are landed within <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}</> seconds. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Frostplume
