pals.description: So precise is its sense of time that it awakens at the exact same hour every morning. According to Palpagos lore, a day was divided into 24 parts because when Frostplume spreads its tail feathers wide, it reveals a pattern with 24 distinct spaces.

partnerSkill.name: Peacock Pounce
partnerSkill.description: While in party, Frostplume's icy aura sharpens focus, increasing the player's <Status_Keyword>reload speeds</> by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Majex
pals.description: It appears to be striking a heroic pose, but the reality is that it's simply bracing itself against the weight of its tail and hair to avoid toppling over.

partnerSkill.name: Phantasmal Arcana
partnerSkill.description: While in party, when the player attacks an enemy afflicted with Unknown Status (ADDITIONAL_EFFECT_Burn| style=|Effect_Burn), the enemy <Status_Keyword>creates flames around itself</>, dealing continuous damage equal to <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</> of the player's attack damage to enemies that come into contact with them. (Does not stack.)

pals.name: Sibelyx
pals.description: A Pal that likes the rain, and will often bask in rain showers until the weather clears up. On rainy days, Foxparks can often be found taking shelter beneath it.

partnerSkill.name: Silk Shroud
partnerSkill.description: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with IcicleThrow| style=|Status_Keyword. When this Pal uses IcicleThrow| style=|Status_Keyword, it has a <Status_Up>x{ActiveSkillMainValueByRank}</> damage multiplier. Sometimes makes cloth2| style=|status_keyword when assigned to Ranch.

pals.name: Sibelyx Primo
pals.description: A Pal that loves gazing into the void, and will often remain completely still. It frequently becomes a gathering spot for smaller Pals.

partnerSkill.name: Gilded Shroud
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases Defense of Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Normal| style=|Elem_Neutral) Pals by {Passive1_EffectValue1}%. (Does not stack) Sometimes makes cloth2| style=|status_keyword when assigned to Ranch.

pals.name: Maraith
pals.description: It relishes the peculiar scent living things give off when they are near death. If a Maraith has taken a liking to you, it is safe to assume that is why.

partnerSkill.name: Messenger of Death
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party, all Party Pals' Active Skill cooldowns are reduced by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</> whenever you defeat an enemy. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Shroomer
pals.description: Inhaling large amounts of its spores will put you into a trance. Sometimes, if Shroomer appears motionless, it's not because it's mimicking a mushroom, but rather because it's high off its own spores.

partnerSkill.name: Rampant Spores
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Sometimes drops mushroom| style=|status_keyword or cavemushroom| style=|status_keyword when assigned to Ranch.

pals.name: Shroomer Noct
pals.description: The abundance of spores released by this Pal blocks out sunlight. Sometimes, if Shroomer Noct appears motionless, it's not because it's mimicking a mushroom, but rather because its own spores don't let it see anything.

partnerSkill.name: Roiling Spores
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While at a base, its mysterious spores slow the rate at which the SAN value of allies at the base decreases by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue2}%</>.

pals.name: Icelyn
pals.description: Though its body melts in the heat, it just can’t resist sunbathing. Though its body melts in the warmth, it likes hot springs too much. If it's going to melt anyway, it hopes it’ll be in a steaming outdoor bath under a clear blue sky.

partnerSkill.name: Witch's Icy Veil
partnerSkill.description: When activated, Icelyn changes the player's attack type to Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Ice| style=|Elem_Ice) and increases Attack by {ReferencePassive1_EffectValue1}%.

pals.name: Gildra
pals.description: The golden, bandage-like organs covering its body are highly elastic. However, they are prone to tearing under extremely dry conditions, so daily moisture checks are absolutely essential.

partnerSkill.name: Resurrection
partnerSkill.description: While fighting together, when Gildra is incapacitated, it <Status_Keyword>revives</> with its Hunger reduced to 0. {ReferenceMsgId_CooldownReduction}

pals.name: Jormuntide
pals.description: Legend says the Jormuntide was once a wise man who, after being wrongly convicted and cast into a whirlpool, returned as this Pal to annihilate the kingdom.

partnerSkill.name: Stormbringer Sea Dragon
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden to travel on water. While in party, increases player's and Pals' damage to enemies afflicted with Unknown Status (ADDITIONAL_EFFECT_Wetness| style=|Effect_Wetness) by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>. (Does not stack) {ReferenceMsgId_RideSpeedUp}

pals.name: Jormuntide Ignis
pals.description: Legend says the Jormuntide Ignis was once a warrior who, after being wrongly convicted and cast into a volcano, returned as this Pal to annihilate the kingdom.

partnerSkill.name: Stormbringer Lava Dragon
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party, <Status_Keyword>nullifies lava damage</> and increases player's and Pals' damage to enemies afflicted with Unknown Status (ADDITIONAL_EFFECT_Burn| style=|Effect_Burn) by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>. (Does not stack) {ReferenceMsgId_RideSpeedUp}

pals.name: Suzaku
pals.description: It was once believed to usher in the dry season. Whenever there was a drought the previous year, people would relentlessly seek to cull its numbers, hoping to bring about a plentiful harvest in the next year.

partnerSkill.name: Wings of Flame
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. This Pal’s Movement Speed increases by {Passive1_EffectValue1}% for each other Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Fire| style=|Elem_Fire) Pal in your party. (Excluding Suzaku)

pals.name: Suzaku Aqua
pals.description: It was once believed to usher in the rainy season. Whenever there was a flood the previous year, people would relentlessly seek to cull its numbers, hoping to avert disaster in the coming year.

partnerSkill.name: Wings of Water
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. This Pal’s Movement Speed increases by {Passive1_EffectValue1}% for each other Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Water| style=|Elem_Water) Pal in your party. (Excluding Suzaku Aqua)

pals.name: Dazemu
pals.description: Take one step forward and forget your doubts. Take two steps forward and forget your worries. Take three steps forward and forget your fears. Face any enemy.

partnerSkill.name: Sand Sprint
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Movement Speed is increased by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</> while mounted <Status_Keyword>on sand</>.

pals.name: Quivern
pals.description: Sleeping while cuddling a Quivern is said to be a heavenly experience, but there are some who have been crushed and sent to heaven by ones that toss and turn in their sleep.

partnerSkill.name: Sky Dragon Affection
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While in party, increases Attack of Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Dragon| style=|Elem_Dragon) Pals by {Passive1_EffectValue1}%. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Quivern Botan
pals.description: When you hug Quivern Botan, if it smells like sunshine and meadows, tomorrow will be sunny. If it smells damp, tomorrow will be wet and miserable.

partnerSkill.name: Grass Dragon Affection
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While mounted, changes the player’s attack type to Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Leaf| style=|Elem_Grass) and increases Attack by {Passive2_EffectValue1}%.

pals.name: Lullu
pals.description: In early spring, pollen floats on the wind throughout the island. Flopie's hay fever is Lullu's fault.

partnerSkill.name: Floral Boost
partnerSkill.description: While at a base, Lullu fills farms with good spirits, increasing the growth rate of the crops by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>.

pals.name: Kikit
pals.description: A decade ago, Kikit soccer was popular. However, it quickly fell out of favor due to fierce opposition from the Free Pal Alliance. Nevertheless, the Kikit's themselves didn't mind because it helped shed their old carapace.

partnerSkill.name: Sandball Soccer
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases Defense of Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Earth| style=|Elem_Ground) Pals by {Passive1_EffectValue1}%. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Yakumo
pals.description: It has a strong sense of justice and despises evil. In the past they were faithful and loving companions to the islanders. Nowadays, Yakumos are hostile to humans wherever they spot them.

partnerSkill.name: Birds of a Feather
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While fighting together, <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</> increased chance of encountering pals with the same Passive Skill as this Pal. (Excludes certain Passive Skills)

pals.name: Skutlass
pals.description: A bizarre species which temporarily separates its body and uses its bones to slice through enemies, at the risk of perishing itself upon taking too long. While unconfirmed, older individuals are said to deliberately stay separated in order to trigger their survival instincts and prolong their lifespans.

partnerSkill.name: Fish Fillet
partnerSkill.description: When activated, Skutlass becomes the player's katana (Attack: <Status_Up>{ActiveSkillMainValueByRank}</>). If it does not revert to its normal form quickly, Skutlass will become incapacitated. It will also become incapacitated if Iaigiri is used.

pals.name: Skutlass Ignis
pals.description: A bizarre species which temporarily separates its body and uses its bones to slice through enemies, at the risk of perishing itself upon taking too long. While unconfirmed, older individuals are said to deliberately stay separated in order to trigger their survival instincts and prolong their lifespans.

partnerSkill.name: Seared Fish Fillet
partnerSkill.description: When activated, Skutlass Ignis becomes the player's katana (Attack: <Status_Up>{ActiveSkillMainValueByRank}</>). If it does not revert to its normal form quickly, Skutlass Ignis will become incapacitated. It will also become incapacitated if Iaigiri is used.

pals.name: Reptyro
pals.description: Magma-like blood runs throughout its body. If a large amount of water is thrown on it, the water rapidly heats, causing an immense vapor explosion.

partnerSkill.name: Ore-Loving Beast
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party, reduces weight of <Status_Keyword>all types of ore</> by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Reptyro Cryst
pals.description: Ice cold blood runs throughout its body. If heated rapidly, its blood evaporates, causing an immense vapor explosion.

partnerSkill.name: Ice-Loving Beast
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party, reduces weight of <Status_Keyword>all types of ore</> by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Starryon
pals.description: It takes great pride in its flowing, gorgeous mane. If it finds a split end, it becomes so mortified it can't focus on running properly. Because static electricity makes its hair frizzy, it avoids Azurmane at all costs.

partnerSkill.name: Night Dancer
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Boosts jumping ability while mounted. This Pal's movement speed increases by <Status_Up>+{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</> at night.

pals.name: Starryon Primo
pals.description: It takes great pride in its glowing, gorgeous mane. If it gets even slightly dirty, it becomes so mortified it can't focus on running properly. Because skin oils ruin its coat, it wants to avoid being touched too much, even by its favorite Pal Tamer.

partnerSkill.name: Light Dancer
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Boosts Jump Power while mounted. This Pal’s Movement Speed increases by {Passive1_EffectValue1}% for each other Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Normal| style=|Elem_Neutral) Pal in your party. (Excluding Starryon Primo)

pals.name: Pierdon
pals.description: It smashes its body against harder rocks to maintain its preferred shape. Those with noticeable dents are best left alone, much like people with a botched haircut.

partnerSkill.name: Power Stone
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases player's and Pals' damage to enemies afflicted with Unknown Status (ADDITIONAL_EFFECT_Muddy| style=|Effect_Muddy) by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Pierdon Cryst
pals.description: It basks in the sun, rotating just enough to melt its ice into its preferred shape. Lopsided ones should be left alone, much like a person who was a little too bold with their sideburns.

partnerSkill.name: Power Crystal
partnerSkill.description: While in party, player and party Pals take {Passive1_EffectValue1}% less Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Dragon| style=|Elem_Dragon) damage. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Cryolinx
pals.description: It can easily climb steep mountains with its hard claws. However, its short legs make it difficult to descend, often leaving it stranded in high places.

partnerSkill.name: Dragon Hunter
partnerSkill.description: While in party, Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Dragon| style=|Elem_Dragon) Pals drop {Passive1_EffectValue1}% more items when defeated. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Cryolinx Terra
pals.description: It can easily carry many items with its large hands. However, its short legs slow its pace, often leaving it overtaken by nightfall.

partnerSkill.name: Explosive Strength
partnerSkill.description: While in party, when attacking <Status_Keyword>enemy weak point</>, increases the power of the next weak point attack by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Snugloo
pals.description: “To look at a Snugloo's eyes” is an expression which means to seek the unseen essence of things. Ironically, no researcher has ever confirmed whether Snugloos have eyes in the first place.

partnerSkill.name: Invisible Eye
partnerSkill.description: While in party, reduces the chance of being detected by enemies. (Does not stack) {ReferenceMsgId_EnemySightRate}

pals.name: Wumpo
pals.description: Researchers once tried to shave off its hair to reveal its true form. In the end, only hair was left, as if that was all there was to begin with.

partnerSkill.name: Guardian of the Snowy Mountain
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While at a base, increases the Unknown Status (COMMON_WORK_SUITABILITY_Transport| style=|Status_Keyword) Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by <Status_Keyword>+{Passive1_EffectValue1}</>. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Wumpo Botan
pals.description: Researchers once tried to cut the grass off its body to reveal its true form. In the end, only grass was left, as if that was all there was to begin with.

partnerSkill.name: Guardian of the South
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party, player and party Pals take {Passive1_EffectValue1}% less Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Earth| style=|Elem_Ground) damage and are immune to Unknown Status (ADDITIONAL_EFFECT_Muddy| style=|Effect_Muddy) status. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Sootseer
pals.description: It was once believed that as the world approached its end, the flame would weaken. Doomsayers would repeatedly rejoice when the flame began to weaken, but in the end, it turned out to be a prank by Sootseer. At least, for now.

partnerSkill.name: Grave Robber
partnerSkill.description: While in party, player and party Pals take {Passive1_EffectValue1}% less Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Normal| style=|Elem_Neutral) damage. (Does not stack) Sometimes digs up bone| style=|status_keyword when assigned to Ranch.

pals.name: Carnibora
pals.description: Prone to eating indiscriminately, the mouth atop its head frequently breaks out in agonizing ulcers, causing it to use the mouth on its face instead. However, its behavior doesn't change, which leads to both mouths suffering the same ulcers.

partnerSkill.name: Entangling Tongue
partnerSkill.description: While in party, when the player performs a dodge roll or dodge step, Carnibora creates a whirlwind that deals damage to enemies it touches (Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Leaf| style=|Elem_Grass) / Power: {Passive1_EffectValue1}). (Does not stack)

pals.name: Blazamut
pals.description: Legends say it was born during a volcanic eruption. A strange group even claims that this continent is laid upon the back of a giant Blazamut.

partnerSkill.name: Magma Kaiser
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party, increases the Attack and Defense of the Pal fighting alongside you by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</> whenever you defeat an enemy. This effect lasts 20 seconds and stacks up to five times.

pals.name: Blazamut Ryu
pals.description: Long ago, it emerged from the depths of the earth. With relentless, raging flames showing no mercy, it burned the entire island until nothing remained. It was known as the Eternal Flame.

partnerSkill.name: Dragon Kaiser
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party, improves player's and Pals' Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Dragon| style=|Elem_Dragon) damage to enemy weak points by {Passive1_EffectValue1}%. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Dualith
pals.description: One entity, two minds. When their wills clash, it's impossible to tell where the armor will wander until they reconcile.

partnerSkill.name: Forest Laser
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. When activated, Dualith fires a powerful Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Leaf| style=|Elem_Grass) laser from its right hand. {ReferenceMsgId_CooldownReduction}

pals.name: Dualith Noct
pals.description: One entity, two minds. They rarely agree and bicker constantly, but once battle begins, mind and body instantly unite as one!

partnerSkill.name: Corruption Laser
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. When activated, Dualith Noct fires a powerful Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Dark| style=|Elem_Dark) laser from its right hand. {ReferenceMsgId_CooldownReduction}

pals.name: Anubis
pals.description: Once seen as a symbol of nobility, and an idol for those who shunned wealth and power. Yet over time, this Pal became a token of death.

partnerSkill.name: Guardian of the Desert
partnerSkill.description: When activated, Anubis changes the player's attack type to Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Earth| style=|Elem_Ground) and increases Attack by {ReferencePassive1_EffectValue1}%. Occasionally evades attacks with a flash sidestep during battle.

pals.name: Sekhmet
pals.description: Once a fierce creature feared as a symbol of death. When Anubis claimed that mantle, wealthy elites looking for a replacement beguiled the species with wine. Before long, Sekhmet became a symbol of high nobility.

partnerSkill.name: Desert Empress
partnerSkill.description: While at base, boosts Unknown Character (Anubis| style=|Status_Keyword)'s work speed by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>. Increases efficiency by <Status_Up>{Passive2_EffectValue1}%</> if Sekhmet is also working at a Workbench, Workshop, or other related facilities. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Prixter
pals.description: It has about 5,000 types of venom. Some of them are deadly enough to cause instant death, but none are present in a high enough concentration to have any effect.

partnerSkill.name: Phantom Venom
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases player's and Pals' damage to enemies afflicted with Unknown Status (ADDITIONAL_EFFECT_Poison| style=|Effect_Poison) by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Prixter Lux
pals.description: It pierces foes with its tail to deliver an electric jolt directly into their bodies. However, the current it generates is extremely weak, so a simple punch would do far more damage.

partnerSkill.name: Scorpion Longwave
partnerSkill.description: When activated, Prixter Lux changes the player's attack type to Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Electricity| style=|Elem_Electric) and increases Attack by {ReferencePassive1_EffectValue1}%.

pals.name: Tetroise
pals.description: Those stones on its back are not just cargo. Set them down somewhere distant and they will slowly make their way back home.

partnerSkill.name: Masonry Archelon
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden While at a base, increases the Unknown Status (COMMON_WORK_SUITABILITY_Mining| style=|Status_Keyword) Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by <Status_Keyword>+{Passive1_EffectValue1}</>. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Tetroise Primo
pals.description: Even if the stones on its back were to be removed, Tetroise Primo will know where they are. No matter how far apart, it will always track them down.

partnerSkill.name: Stone-Chaser Archelon
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party, increases the durability of all <Status_Keyword>weapons</> and <Status_Keyword>armor</> by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Nyafia
pals.description: Strongly dislikes anyone catching a glimpse of its concealed eye. If you insist on trying, it'll burst into tears and ignore you for two weeks.

partnerSkill.name: Shot-Nyan Mode
partnerSkill.description: When activated, Nyafia will fire a shotgun at nearby enemies for a limited time. While in party, increases the player's shotgun damage by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Mimog
pals.description: There was once a tradition of handing out an award to the person who met their end in the most foolish way. The first award was given for |being unaware of Mimog, opening the chest, and being bitten to death.|

partnerSkill.name: Master of Unlocking
partnerSkill.description: While fighting together, Mimog can open treasure chests without using a key. {ReferenceMsgId_CooldownReduction}

pals.name: Xenovader
pals.description: Can send information and convert it into energy by forgetting it. Regularly seems to be sending information to someone. - Respond. Target located. Proceed to immediate destruction.

partnerSkill.name: Unknown Invader
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases the damage of the last bullet fired from a full-auto weapon by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Xenogard
pals.description: Consumes information and turns it into energy. Regularly seems to be sending information to someone. - Hello? What was the message you just sent? I devoured it before checking.

partnerSkill.name: Unknown Intruder
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party, increases the player's <Status_Keyword>energy weapon</> damage by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Prunelia
pals.description: Intelligent and graceful in its demeanor, it was frequently employed as an attendant by the island's nobles. However, when encountered at night, its face looked so eerie that it quickly fell out of favor.

partnerSkill.name: Prayer for Abundant Harvest
partnerSkill.description: While at a base, Prunelia's prayers bless the crops, increasing their harvest by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>.

pals.name: Nitemary
pals.description: What it carries is its own soul. When it falls for someone, it forcibly extracts their soul and merges it with its own, yearning to become one.

partnerSkill.name: Soul Collector
partnerSkill.description: While fighting together, Pals drop <Status_Up>+{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</> more Pal Souls when defeated. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Nitemary Botan
pals.description: What it carries is its own soul. When it falls for someone, it flings its soul at them to merge it with theirs, yearning to become one.

partnerSkill.name: Soul Binder
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases Defense of Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Leaf| style=|Elem_Grass) Pals by {Passive1_EffectValue1}%. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Smokie
pals.description: The black flames are merely warm to the touch, but anything left in contact with them slowly melts from the inside. Hold some cheese over them, and it becomes a true delicacy.

partnerSkill.name: Dig, Smokie! Dig!
partnerSkill.description: When activated, uses its sharp sense of smell to detect nearby chromium| style=|status_keyword. While fighting together, chromium| style=|status_keyword acquisition increases by <Status_Up>+{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>.

pals.name: Smokie Cryst
pals.description: The blue flames are merely cool to the touch, but anything left in contact with them slowly freezes. Hold a milk bottle over them, and you get a frozen milkshake!

partnerSkill.name: Cryo Instincts
partnerSkill.description: While at a base, increases the Unknown Status (COMMON_WORK_SUITABILITY_Cool| style=|Status_Keyword) Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by <Status_Keyword>+{Passive1_EffectValue1}</>. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Omascul
pals.description: The mask it wears is not its face, they say. It seems in front, but it's not there, no way. From shadows deep, it watches night and day. Glance away, and closer it will stray.

partnerSkill.name: Masquerade Dance
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases Party Pals' <Status_Keyword>EXP gained</> by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Whalaska
pals.description: When it sleeps, Pals often mistake it for a drifting piece of ice and rest on it. Although gentle and unwilling to push them away when awake, it feels quietly stressed by the intrusion on its personal space.

partnerSkill.name: Chilled Whale Cruiser
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party, fishing minigames start with the capture gauge increased by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>. Additionally, while the bars overlap, capture progress increases by <Status_Up>{Passive2_EffectValue1}%</>. (Does not stack) {ReferenceMsgId_SwimSpeedUp}

pals.name: Whalaska Ignis
pals.description: Determined never to be mistaken for drift ice again, it turned bright red through sheer will. Unfortunately, some Pals can’t see red. So despite its efforts, its personal space continues to be invaded.

partnerSkill.name: Cozy Whale Cruiser
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party, fishing minigame begins with the capture gauge <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</> higher than usual, and capture progress increases by <Status_Up>{Passive2_EffectValue1}%</> while the bars overlap. (Does not stack) {ReferenceMsgId_SwimSpeedUp}

pals.name: Verdash
pals.description: Land that Verdash has run across becomes extremely fertile, with thick vegetation growing soon after. It will not run anywhere that herbicide has been used.

partnerSkill.name: Grassland Gymnast
partnerSkill.description: While in party, grants <Status_Keyword>{Passive1_EffectValue1}</> additional jump and <Status_Keyword>{Passive1_EffectValue2}</> additional mid-air dash. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Splatterina
pals.description: It has an uncontrollable urge to tear its prey apart. Each individual has their own meticulous order for dismemberment. If caught by Splatterina, pray that your head is taken first.

partnerSkill.name: Blade of Uncontrolled Passion
partnerSkill.description: While in party, the amount of items obtained from using the Meat Cleaver increases by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Gildane
pals.description: During the golden age of alchemy on the island, its ever-glowing golden fur was highly prized as a catalyst for transmuting gold. In time, a remarkable revelation was made: the same golden hue could be achieved simply by processing its mane.

partnerSkill.name: Sandstorm's Blessing
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While mounted, changes the player’s attack type to Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Earth| style=|Elem_Ground) and increases Attack by {Passive2_EffectValue1}%.

pals.name: Dogen
pals.description: Striving for a state of selflessness, it meditates endlessly. After confronting its worldly desires, it eats a meal and reflects. It ate too much today.

partnerSkill.name: Homeward Prayer
partnerSkill.description: When activated, teleports to the nearest base. Cannot be used inside dungeons or similar areas. {ReferenceMsgId_CooldownReduction}

pals.name: Bulldosu
pals.description: In the old islands, Bulldosu sumo was widely enjoyed. At the highest levels, even a charging Rushoar would be sent flying instead.

partnerSkill.name: Yokozuna's Presence
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party, player and party Pals take {Passive1_EffectValue1}% less Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Electricity| style=|Elem_Electric) damage and are immune to Unknown Status (ADDITIONAL_EFFECT_Electrical| style=|Effect_Electrical). (Does not stack)

pals.name: Celesdir
pals.description: Ancient texts refer to it as the |Beast of Salvation.| The light emitted by Celesdir purifies everything, literally causing things to vanish from existence without leaving a trace.

partnerSkill.name: Blessing of Purification
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. This Pal's Attack and Movement Speed increases by {Passive2_EffectValue1}% for each other Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Normal| style=|Elem_Neutral) Pal in your party. When in party, recovers Health of the player and Party Pals by {Passive1_EffectValue1}% per second. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Celesdir Noct
pals.description: Where blinding radiance shines, dark shadows are born. It scatters an all-enveloping darkness to reclaim the chaos that ought to be. Balance is what the world requires.

partnerSkill.name: Blessing of Chaos
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party, the Pal fighting alongside you gradually loses Health in exchange for <Status_Up>{ReferencePassive1_EffectValue1}%</> Attack increase. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Astegon
pals.description: A savage beast born of the abyss. Thou shall not stand before the beast. Thou shall not heed the beast.

partnerSkill.name: Black Ankylosaur
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Increases the damage dealt to ores by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>, and you can obtain <Status_Up>{Passive2_EffectValue1}%</> more copperore| style=|status_keyword while mounted.

pals.name: Knocklem
pals.description: Can be disassembled into 215 parts. It is capable of being reassembled and functioning again even if the parts are scattered. Mixing parts from different individuals will trigger a malfunction due to mistaken identity.

partnerSkill.name: Steel Guardian Mode
partnerSkill.description: When activated, a steel resolve increases Knocklem's Attack by <Status_Up>{ReferencePassive1_EffectValue1}%</> and Defense by <Status_Up>{ReferencePassive2_EffectValue1}%</> for a limited time.

pals.name: Knocklem Ignis
pals.description: Upon disassembly, it is capable of being reassembled and functioning again. Mixing parts from different individuals will trigger a fatal cognitive error that causes its systems to overheat.

partnerSkill.name: Iron Guardian Mode
partnerSkill.description: When activated, a steel resolve increases Knocklem Ignis's Attack by <Status_Up>{ReferencePassive1_EffectValue1}%</> and Defense by <Status_Up>{ReferencePassive2_EffectValue1}%</> for a limited time.

pals.name: Silvegis
pals.description: The metallic components around its neck possess magnetic properties. If the leg pieces get too close, they cling to it. When metal debris builds up on its neck, it grudgingly begins cleaning, and grows frustrated when they won't come off easily.

partnerSkill.name: Aegis Shield
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party, reduces shield regeneration delay by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</> and reduces damage taken by your shield by <Status_Up>{Passive2_EffectValue1}%</>. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Azurmane
pals.description: Like Univolt, it was once believed to be connected to the Thunder God. As faith in Univolt waned, Azurmane was deemed the God's true envoy. Even so, time reduced both to the same lowly status of ordinary workhorses.

partnerSkill.name: Plasma Dash
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Grants <Status_Keyword>Air Dash</>, to move at even higher speeds. {ReferenceMsgId_ShortDashSpeedCoolTime}

pals.name: Valentail
pals.description: In older paintings, it is depicted as much smaller than it is today. For reasons unknown, various parts of its body have begun to elongate rapidly in recent years, and it is predicted to reach nearly ten times its current size within the next century.

partnerSkill.name: Big Stretch
partnerSkill.description: While in party, reduces the effects of gravity on the player, making them more floaty while jumping and falling. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Snock
pals.description: Tossing an Snock into the bath for a shock spa is considered a traditional health practice. That is to say, the results may be rather shocking.

partnerSkill.name: Charging Shell
partnerSkill.description: While in party, the player's attacks inflict Unknown Status (ADDITIONAL_EFFECT_Electrical| style=|Effect_Electrical) <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}</>. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Snock Lux
pals.description: Tossing a heated Snock Lux into the bath for a scorching spa was once a fad of the distant past. Owing to a recent revival, it is now quite literally a hot trend.

partnerSkill.name: Grounding Shell
partnerSkill.description: While in party, player and party Pals take {Passive1_EffectValue1}% less Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Water| style=|Elem_Water) damage, and are immune to Unknown Status (ADDITIONAL_EFFECT_Wetness| style=|Effect_Wetness). (Does not stack)

pals.name: Souffline
pals.description: Its fluff can be used to hide away unpleasant memories. Once carried off by the wind, you can bid farewell to the darkness they carried.

partnerSkill.name: Fuzzy Fairy
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases the capture rate of Pals afflicted with Unknown Status (ADDITIONAL_EFFECT_IvyCling| style=|Effect_IvyCling). (Does not stack) {ReferenceMsgId_CaptureRate}

pals.name: Lapiron
pals.description: Listens to the earth as it runs, avoiding unstable footing with ease. However, uncooperative terrain will trick it into falling over constantly.

partnerSkill.name: Friend of Earth
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases the player's Defense by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</> while sprinting. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Hoodle
pals.description: When it sleeps, it deflates. When it sleeps, it's no longer there. A sleeping Hoodle cannot exist; Therefore, Hoodle never sleeps.

partnerSkill.name: Void-Dweller
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases the player's damage dealt to enemies that are not in combat by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Slowatt
pals.description: Doing as they please, sleeping when they wish, and eating whatever they like. Surely, Slowatt must be toiling in secret to maintain such a luxury. ...Or so the old islanders told themselves, just to get by.

partnerSkill.name: Chillswitch
partnerSkill.description: While in party, when the player attacks an enemy afflicted with Unknown Status (ADDITIONAL_EFFECT_Electrical| style=|Effect_Electrical), the enemy <Status_Keyword>discharges electricity</>, dealing damage equal to <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</> of the player's attack damage to nearby enemies. (Does not stack.)

pals.name: Bakemi
pals.description: It lives entirely for the thrill of the scare, but is utterly un-frightening. As most cannot help but indulge it with feigned surprise for its cuteness, Bakemi now leaves a trail of smiles in its wake.

partnerSkill.name: Grinning Death
partnerSkill.description: While in party, attacking enemies afflicted with Unknown Status (ADDITIONAL_EFFECT_Poison| style=|Effect_Poison) reduces their Attack by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Solmora
pals.description: Its corkscrew tail acts as a propeller. Research claims that if its body could withstand the strain, it could reach speeds beyond 88 mph.

partnerSkill.name: Charming Fish
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden to travel on water. While in party, makes it easier to fish up <Status_Keyword>talented Pals</>. (Does not stack) {ReferenceMsgId_SwimSpeedUp}

pals.name: Solmora Lux
pals.description: Its corkscrew tail acts as a propeller. Research claims that if its body could withstand the strain, it could generate over 1.21 gigawatts of power.

partnerSkill.name: Shocking Fish
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden to travel on water. While mounted, changes the player's attack type to Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Electricity| style=|Elem_Electric) and increases Attack by {Passive2_EffectValue1}%. While in party, makes it easier to fish up talented Pals. (Does not stack) {ReferenceMsgId_SwimSpeedUp}

pals.name: Lapure
pals.description: It uses the long, flowing fur on its hands to attract attention, always taking the utmost care to keep them maintained. Highly sensitive to dirt and meticulously clean, kicking up dust nearby will invite a very disgusted glare.

partnerSkill.name: Long-Sleeved Hurray
partnerSkill.description: While in party, reduces the <Status_Keyword>Partner Skill cooldowns</> for other party Pals by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue2}%</>. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Eidrolon
pals.description: A new Pal that was only recently discovered. Calm and entirely docile, it spends its time as it pleases. It is no longer bound by anything.

partnerSkill.name: Liberated Pterosaur
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. This Pal's Attack and Movement Speed increase by {Passive1_EffectValue1}% for each other Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Dragon| style=|Elem_Dragon)or Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Dark| style=|Elem_Dark) Pal in your party.

pals.name: Eidrolon Ignis
pals.description: A new Pal that was only recently discovered. It trusts nothing and no one, and its tempermental nature leads to it constantly venting its rage at the nearest target.

partnerSkill.name: Resentful Pterosaur
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. This Pal's Attack and Movement Speed increase by {Passive1_EffectValue1}% or each other Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Dragon| style=|Elem_Dragon) or Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Fire| style=|Elem_Fire) Pal in your party. (Excluding Eidrolon Ignis)

pals.name: Dynamoff
pals.description: With so little to eat at high altitudes, it will occasionally even feast on its enemies' brains. It is thought that groups seeking a more dependable food source descended to lower skies, ultimately diverging into Beakon.

partnerSkill.name: Electro-Massage Incubation
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While at a base, shortens the time it takes to incubate eggs by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Tropicaw
pals.description: While some say that it flails around to mimic flowers swaying in the wind and avoid predators, others argue that a crimson flower thrashing violently at high speeds is simply so unsettling that nothing dares approach it.

partnerSkill.name: Flower Dance
partnerSkill.description: While in party, extends the invincibility period during dodge rolls and dodge steps by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue2}%</>. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Flaracle
pals.description: It focuses its mind and reads the future through flames. Should it glimpse an inconvenient destiny, it relentlessly rerolls the prophecy until it gets a favorable result. That is why the future of Flaracle is always exceptionally bright!

partnerSkill.name: Burning Future
partnerSkill.description: While in party, when the player attacks an enemy afflicted with Unknown Status (ADDITIONAL_EFFECT_Burn| style=|Effect_Burn), the enemy <Status_Keyword>explodes</>, dealing damage equal to <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</> of the player's attack damage to nearby enemies. (Does not stack.)

pals.name: Ophydia
pals.description: Waters where Ophydias dwell are often filled with flowers that mimic its form. Many attempts have been made to directly propagate these blooms, but they inevitably wither the moment human hands interfere.

partnerSkill.name: Glorious Mist
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party, the player's attacks inflict Unknown Status (ADDITIONAL_EFFECT_Wetness| style=|Effect_Wetness) <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}</>. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Dupin
pals.description: A copy it created might quietly replace it, leaving even the Dupin itself unsure whether it is still the original.

partnerSkill.name: Trick-Loving Fluffle
partnerSkill.description: While in party, when the player's Health falls below 50%, Dupin generates an explosion around the player (Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Fire| style=|Elem_Fire) / Power: {Passive1_EffectValue1} / Unknown Status (ADDITIONAL_EFFECT_Burn| style=|Effect_Burn) buildup: {ReferencePassive1_EffectValue1}). Additionally, while the player's Health is below 50%, the player's Attack is increased by {Passive2_EffectValue1}%. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Roujay
pals.description: A thief by nature, it snatches items when no one is looking. No reason to be concerned when caught in the act. Once it swiftly steals your eyes, you won’t be seeing anything anyway.

partnerSkill.name: Dark-Nester
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While in party, increases player's and Pals' damage to enemies afflicted with Unknown Status (ADDITIONAL_EFFECT_Darkness| style=|Effect_Darkness) by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Venusa
pals.description: Whenever it's confused, it resorts to consulting with the snakes on its head. However, since they're all ultimately the same being, it comes to understand that nothing is understood.

partnerSkill.name: Snake's Sagacity
partnerSkill.description: While in party, the player's attacks inflict Unknown Status (ADDITIONAL_EFFECT_Darkness| style=|Elem_Dark) <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}</>. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Mycora
pals.description: It views humans as nothing more than convenient parasitic hosts. The reason Mycora has taken this form is to deceive humans into lowering their guard, allowing its spores to spread more efficiently.

partnerSkill.name: Charming Spore
partnerSkill.description: While at a base, increases the Unknown Status (COMMON_WORK_SUITABILITY_ProductMedicine| style=|Status_Keyword) Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by <Status_Keyword>+{Passive1_EffectValue1}</>. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Loomen
pals.description: Its lantern glows with an eerie light that lays bare the truth of the world. If that light strikes you as blinding, then you most likely have something to hide.

partnerSkill.name: Lantern Enchantment
partnerSkill.description: While in party, the player's arrows <Status_Keyword>explode on contact</>, dealing additional damage equal to <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</> of the player's attack damage. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Wistella
pals.description: At the end of its life, a new star appears somewhere in the skies, glowing with the weight of its memories.

partnerSkill.name: Hidden Dark Energy
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases Defense of Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Dark| style=|Elem_Dark) Pals by {Passive1_EffectValue1}%. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Solenne
pals.description: Joy and misery come in equal measure for Solenne. Those who choose to take care of one must be prepared for what that entails.

partnerSkill.name: Untainted Maiden
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases the player's Attack by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</> if all Pals in party are different species. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Renjishi
pals.description: At a glance, its movements appear exaggerated and full of openings. Strangely, however, any opponents become overwhelmed, and become unable to look away, as if transfixed.

partnerSkill.name: Stage Combat
partnerSkill.description: While in party, the player's attacks inflict Unknown Status (ADDITIONAL_EFFECT_Burn| style=|Effect_Burn) <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}</>. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Aegidron
pals.description: In ancient times, when means of communication were limited, the light within Aegidron's wings was used to send simple flash signals.

partnerSkill.name: Indestructible Fortress
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party, player and party Pals take <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue2}%</> less damage from <Status_Keyword>explosive attacks</>, and are immune to Unknown Status (ADDITIONAL_EFFECT_Stun| style=|Effect_Stun). (Does not stack)

pals.name: Grizzbolt
pals.description: With a friendly smile and a hardy physique, it is docile towards one it recognizes as a partner. For reasons unexplained, its personality undergoes a drastic change when wielding a minigun.

partnerSkill.name: Yellow Tank
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Can rapidly fire a minigun while mounted. {ReferenceMsgId_DamageUp}

pals.name: Lyleen
pals.description: A docile Pal full of love. It watches over small Pals who have lost their parents. It uses a full-power Solar Blast to discipline naughty Pals.

partnerSkill.name: Harvest Goddess
partnerSkill.description: When activated, the queen's soothing graces restore the Health of the player and Party Pals by <Status_Up>{ActiveSkillMainValueByRank}%</>.

pals.name: Lyleen Noct
pals.description: An elegant Pal full of grace. It admonishes any who are disrespectful with a painful slap. Some Pals actively seek out this punishment.

partnerSkill.name: Goddess of the Tranquil Light
partnerSkill.description: When activated, the queen's soothing graces restore the Health of the player and Party Pals by <Status_Up>{ActiveSkillMainValueByRank}%</>.

pals.name: Orserk
pals.description: It sends electricity into its foes' wounds, roasting them from the inside out. Fights between Orserk end in the blink of an eye.

partnerSkill.name: Ferocious Thunder Dragon
partnerSkill.description: While in party, hitting an enemy with a bullet increases the Attack and Defense of the Pal fighting alongside you by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</> for 5 seconds. This effect stacks up to 30 times. (Does not stack.)

pals.name: Faleris
pals.description: When it finds its prey it unleashes a whirlwind of flames, burning the entire area to ash. Faleris breath is known for its pleasing scent.

partnerSkill.name: Scorching Predator
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While in party, Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Ice| style=|Elem_Ice) Pals drop {Passive1_EffectValue1}% more items when defeated. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Faleris Aqua
pals.description: When it finds its prey, it unleashes a mighty torrent, sweeping the entire area. More often than not, the prey gets swept away in the chaos, leaving one to wonder whether this truly counts as hunting.

partnerSkill.name: Tidal Predator
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While in party, Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Fire| style=|Elem_Fire) Pals drop {Passive1_EffectValue1}% more items when defeated. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Shadowbeak
pals.description: Born from the depths of insanity, its very existence defies reason. Having lost all genetic ties to other Pals, one wonders if it could still even be considered a Pal.

partnerSkill.name: Modified DNA
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While flying, Movement Speed is increased. Enhances Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Dark| style=|Elem_Dark) attacks by {Passive1_EffectValue1}% while mounted.

pals.name: Selyne
pals.description: The object floating behind, resembling the moon, is said to gradually become more circular with each passing generation. No one knows what will happen when the moon is full.

partnerSkill.name: Celestial Darkness
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While mounted, enhances Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Normal| style=|Elem_Neutral) and Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Dark| style=|Elem_Dark) attacks by {Passive1_EffectValue1}%.

pals.name: Bastigor
pals.description: The sight of anything round gives it an uncontrollable urge to punch it. For Bastigor the toughest challenge, after simply living, is making a snowman.

partnerSkill.name: Blizzard Crash
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While mounted, delivers crushing blows with a hammer forged from Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Ice| style=|Elem_Ice). {ReferenceMsgId_DamageUp}

pals.name: Shaolong
pals.description: Its ring is reserved for a special occasion: upon meeting its destined companion, the rings are traded, a symbol of their eternal partnership.

partnerSkill.name: Azure Sovereign
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. This Pal's Attack increases by {Passive1_EffectValue1}% for each other Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Dragon| style=|Elem_Dragon) Pal in your party.

pals.name: Silvance
pals.description: Since ancient times, it has remained within the World Tree, continuing its vigil. What it protects, and for what purpose, Silvance does not know. After all, the World Tree will tell it everything. The spores it commands surely know who the enemy is.

partnerSkill.name: Spore Stalwart
partnerSkill.description: While in party, when the player attacks an enemy afflicted with Unknown Status (ADDITIONAL_EFFECT_IvyCling| style=|Effect_IvyCling), the enemy <Status_Keyword>explodes</>, dealing additional damage equal to <Status_Up>{Passive2_EffectValue1}%</> of the player's attack damage. (Does not stack) Also grants <Status_Keyword>immunity to the World Tree's Explosive Spores</> to both the player and their Pals.

pals.name: Dandilord
pals.description: Since ancient times, it has remained within the World Tree, continuing its vigil. What it protects, and for what purpose, Dandilord does not care. After all, the World Tree knows everything. Only the mist it wields can reveal the truth.

partnerSkill.name: Mist Stalwart
partnerSkill.description: When activated, the player's attacks inflict Unknown Status (ADDITIONAL_EFFECT_Poison| style=|Effect_Poison) <Status_Up>{ReferencePassive1_EffectValue1}</>. While in party, grants the player and party Pals immunity to Unknown Status (ADDITIONAL_EFFECT_Poison| style=|Effect_Poison), and <Status_Keyword>nullifies the effects of toxic gas</> in the World Tree area. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Bellanoir
pals.description: Without existing, she quietly gazed upon the world. One day, she was seized with a longing to be seen. With unbridled lust for vengeance against reality, thus was born the Eclipsed Siren.

partnerSkill.name: Nightmare Iris
partnerSkill.description: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with Unique_NightLady_WarpBeam_Straight| style=|Status_Keyword. When this Pal uses Unique_NightLady_WarpBeam_Straight| style=|Status_Keyword, it has a <Status_Up>x{ActiveSkillMainValueByRank}</> damage multiplier.

pals.name: Bellanoir Libero
pals.description: With her desires set loose, she was soon overwhelmed. She longed for a self to gaze upon herself. And the sisters who gazed, resenting reality, were driven into the abyss and, at last, closed their eyes.

partnerSkill.name: Nightmare Stare
partnerSkill.description: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with Unique_NightLady_WarpBeam| style=|Status_Keyword. When this Pal uses Unique_NightLady_WarpBeam| style=|Status_Keyword, it has a <Status_Up>x{ActiveSkillMainValueByRank}</> damage multiplier.

pals.name: Xenolord
pals.description: -Destination reached. Priority: Locate entity |Supersonic Dragon| -Note: Conquest deadline exceeded by <://Error_Code:126DC> years. -Update: No conquest traces found. Naturalization confirmed. Commence elimination protocol. -Staff Memo: Refrain from forgetting or consuming critical data!

partnerSkill.name: Meteor Wings
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While in party, damage done by <Status_Keyword>Partner Skills of weapon-wielding Pals</> increases by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>. (Does not stack) {ReferenceMsgId_RideSpeedUp}

pals.name: Hartalis
pals.description: The silence is unsettling, yet strangely soothing. No one else remains. All have been delivered. O King of Salvation, carry me too into eternal stillness. -The ancient text cuts off here.

partnerSkill.name: Sacred Barrier
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While mounted, it generates a barrier that blocks all attacks. Can <Status_Keyword>triple jump</> while mounted. {ReferenceMsgId_CooldownReduction}

pals.name: Paladius
pals.description: Once one with Necromus. Its gleaming form is free of all negative emotions. However, a glimmer of hatred can still be seen deep within its eyes.

partnerSkill.name: Holy Knight of the Firmament
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Can <Status_Keyword>triple jump</> while mounted. Activate Unique_SaintCentaur_OneSpearRushes| style=|Status_Keyword to have Necromus stay by your side and attack enemies in tandem. {ReferenceMsgId_RideSpeedUp}

pals.name: Necromus
pals.description: Once one with Paladius. Its darkened form is the embodiment of negative emotions. However, a glimmer of compassion can still be seen deep within its eyes.

partnerSkill.name: Dark Knight of the Abyss
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Can <Status_Keyword>double jump</> while mounted. When Unique_BlackCentaur_TwoSpearRushes| style=|Status_Keyword skill is activated, a Paladius in your party will appear and attack alongside you. {ReferenceMsgId_RideSpeedUp}

pals.name: Frostallion
pals.description: Guardian deity of Palpagos Island, known as the Winter Caller. In the past, when a calamity struck the land, it soared into the sky and sealed away the threat by casting the island into eternal winter.

partnerSkill.name: Icy Steed
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While mounted, changes the player's attack type to Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Ice| style=|Elem_Ice), inflict Unknown Status (ADDITIONAL_EFFECT_Freeze| style=|Elem_Ice) {Passive3_EffectValue1}, increases Attack by {Passive2_EffectValue1}%.

pals.name: Frostallion Noct
pals.description: Guardian deity of Palpagos Island, known as the Night Caller. In the past, when a calamity struck the land, it soared into the sky and sealed away the threat by casting the island into eternal darkness.

partnerSkill.name: Black Steed
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While mounted, changes the player's attack type to Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Dark| style=|Elem_Dark), inflict Unknown Status (ADDITIONAL_EFFECT_Darkness| style=|Elem_Dark) {Passive3_EffectValue1}, increases Attack by {Passive2_EffectValue1}%.

pals.name: Neptilius
pals.description: After the sealing of the calamity, a champion from Feybreak emerged. It stares out to sea, awaiting one it deems worthy. For such encounters are no coincidence—they are fate.

partnerSkill.name: Sentinel of the Great Sea
partnerSkill.description: While in party, it follows up the player's attacks with Unknown Status (COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Water| style=|Elem_Water) spear strikes. Can be ridden to travel on water. While mounted, it can leap high into the air over water. {ReferenceMsgId_SwimSpeedUp_CooldownReduction}

pals.name: Jetragon
pals.description: Watches over Palpagos Island from high above. When calamity returns to the land, the earth will split open, and the skies will burn. It is destined to strike down the calamity in a flash of total destruction.

partnerSkill.name: Aerial Missile
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Can rapidly fire a missile launcher while mounted. {ReferenceMsgId_DamageUp}

pals.name: Panthalus
pals.description: The last of its species, keeping its sacred duty close to heart. Even should its long obligation ever be fulfilled, its cries for its mother would only be answered by a solitary echo.

partnerSkill.name: Resonant Guardian
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Only 1 can be summoned to a base. While at a base, it constantly patrols the skies and bombards intruders from high above. {ReferenceMsgId_DamageUp}

pals.name: Astralym
pals.description: A shadow of its former self, this mysterious Pal descended upon the Palpagos long ago. Bringing ruin and calamity, it was sealed away for millennia until it was ultimately defeated by a certain Pal Tamer
